jobs.title: Finance Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Finance Project Coordinator

**Location:** Hybrid (Culver City)

**Department:** Finance

**Reports to:** Director of Finance

**About the job**

* LA based preferred, able to work a hybrid schedule with office hours in Culver City, CA.
* Applications must include a portfolio link, including password if applicable, for consideration

 **Infinity Marketing Team**


A fully integrated and award winning marketing, event, and promotion agency, Infinity Marketing Team (IMT) creates and executes campaigns designed specifically for each of our clients’ brand objectives. With unparalleled expertise in event executions, exhibit environments, mobile marketing tours, digital marketing, event furnishings, and brand marketing strategies, IMT offers numerous means for our clients to achieve premium outcomes. We Create. We Implement. We Show Results!


From spectacular filmed and streamed event productions to jaw\-dropping international conferences and tradeshow displays to globally recognized mobile marketing tours and influencer crossovers, IMT uses an infinite realm of methods to assist companies in strengthening their brands and enhancing their voices in the marketplace. In over 10,000 event marketing campaigns, IMT maintains our guiding belief \- there are no boundaries and there are no limits.

**About the Role**


The Finance Project Coordinator is responsible for financial management of experiential marketing projects including oversight of revenue recognition, financial reporting, forecasting, and process compliance. The Project Finance Coordinator will function as the Business liaison on larger or more complex projects or clients including contract and pricing negotiations (with oversight).

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Servicing**

* Coordinate data collection for client audits
* Communicate with internal project teams regarding budgets, billing, and accounts receivable issues
* Maintain catalog of required client reporting and ensure timely completion

**Financial Management and Planning**

* Support project teams in building and entering client budgets, responding to RFP’s and developing budgets (with oversight)
* Ensure that projects are managed in accordance with contracts; create summary sheets for account and project teams
* Ensure written client agreements are obtained (via contract, letter of agreement, signed SOW, etc.) for all work and are appropriately archived and classified. Liaise with Contract Specialists and Legal.
* Assist project teams with monthly project budget to actual tracking and other required client reporting
* Review and approve scopes and staffing plans; escalate issues to finance lead as appropriate.
* Review monthly fee and expense details. Analyze accuracy and explain significant variances to budget or forecast
* Prepare management reports and identify and communicate areas of concern and suggested improvements to project staff and management (e.g., client profitability, utilization, over/under service, missing time, revenue risk and staffing plans)
* Facilitate monthly billing liaison between project team and finance/accounting department and review billing reports
* Review time and expense write\-offs and unbilled WIP
* Work with project team to minimize risk exposure surrounding accounts receivables and credit requirements of clients
* Accountable for timely and valuable AR collection status commentary and liaison with Accounts Receivable
* Supervise project set up process for project team and perform finance liaison role for larger or more complex projects.
* Drive profitability by working with accounts, production, and management
* Review staffing utilization, realization, and capacity and proactively communicate meaningful observations with leaders
* Ensure compliance with company financial policies (e.g., revenue recognition, project requisitions, time entry, travel and expense, credit, billing, accounts payable, new business)
* Ad hoc requests and projects

**Qualifications**

* The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting with two years of Finance or Accounting experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills.

**Preferred Knowledge And Skills**

* The ideal candidate will have excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, be client service oriented and foster positive working relationships.
* Is well organized with strong time management skills and attention to detail, follows through on multiple projects and juggle conflicting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* The candidate will also possess strong financial analysis and management skills, good business acumen, ability to articulate financial concerns in layman’s terms, and be a self\-starter and initiative taker.
* Advanced knowledge of financial systems.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Paid holidays, PTO, and recovery days
* Opportunities for career growth and creative collaboration
* A culture that values inclusivity, hustle, fun, and innovation

jobs.title: Project Coordinator Intern
jobs.description:
**ABOUT CIM GROUP:**
CIM is a community\-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900\+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. Our focus on enhancing communities is unwavering, and we strive to make an even greater impact in the years to come. Join us and make an impact today!### **POSITION PURPOSE:**



The Project Coordinator Intern will support strategic initiatives at the intersection of project management, data, technology, and business operations. Working alongside project managers, data analysts, and business and technical stakeholders, the intern will help coordinate projects, support firm\-wide programs, develop reporting for senior leadership, and contribute to AI engagement and adoption initiatives. This internship provides hands\-on experience with planning and executing complex programs across the front and back office of a leading investment management firm.



### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Coordinate a project from planning through completion by organizing contributors, maintaining the project plan, tracking milestones and risks, and following up on deliverables with guidance from experienced project managers.
* Support delivery on some of the firm’s largest strategic programs, such as data modernization, by coordinating workstreams, gathering and documenting business requirements and process flows, and helping keep timelines and deliverables on track.
* Develop and help build data and reporting for senior leadership—turning program and operational data into clear dashboards, status reporting, and compelling narratives and visualizations that help inform decisions.
* Support AI engagement and enablement initiatives—helping roll out AI tools across teams, gathering and documenting use cases, and supporting adoption and change management.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements documents, process maps, meeting minutes, and action items, to ensure clarity and accountability.
* Gain hands\-on exposure across real estate, infrastructure, and credit, learning how a diversified alternatives asset manager operates end\-to\-end.
### **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: (including certification, licenses, etc.)**

Required


* Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Business, Finance, or a related quantitative or analytical field.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfort working with data and translating it into insights, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel (e.g., pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical audiences.
* Genuine interest in project management, business operations, and how large organizations plan and execute complex, data\-driven initiatives, along with a curiosity about AI and how modern tools are applied to real business problems.


Preferred


* Exposure to project management concepts, methodologies (e.g., Agile/Scrum, Waterfall), or tools (e.g., Jira, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday) through coursework, clubs, or prior internships.
* Familiarity with data visualization or reporting tools (e.g., Domo, Power BI, Tableau) and the Microsoft Office Suite, or a strong aptitude and eagerness to learn them quickly.
* Prior internship, research, or leadership experience in financial services, investment management, consulting, or a related field.
### **ABOUT YOU:**


* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to work with people across different teams and influence without direct authority.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and comfortable handling ambiguity.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, with intellectual curiosity, high standards, and a proactive, self\-directed approach to open\-ended problems.
* A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn from experienced professionals across the firm.
Actual base salary considers several factors including but not limited to geography, job\-related knowledge, experience, and budget. The start of the salary range is typically associated with the minimum experience required. The role is considered non\-exempt so will be eligible for overtime pay in accordance with federal and state law. The anticipated base pay for the position in Los Angeles, CA is $20 per hour.  

**HOW WE FEEL ABOUT DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION:**
At CIM Group, we believe that the unique perspectives and backgrounds of our employees enhance everything we do. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where diversity is not only respected but celebrated. We strive to ensure that our workplace is free from discrimination and harassment, allowing everyone to contribute meaningfully and feel a sense of belonging. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit any form of unlawful discrimination and adhere to the laws enforced by the EEOC. Our goal is to provide a safe and supportive environment where all employees can grow and make impactful contributions together.

jobs.title: Administrative College & Clinical Education Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Administrative College \& Clinical Education Operations Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** College of Health Professions

**LOCATION:** Hybrid \- On\-campus (80% \- 4 days) and Remote (20% \- 1 day)

**FSLA STATUS:** Non\-exempt

**REPORTS TO:** Dean of College of Health Professions

**COMPENSATION:** $27\.50/Hour

**GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:**

This position is primarily responsible for coordinating day\-to\-day administrative tasks for the College of Health Professions and dedicated to the Dean by performing the following duties.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Coordinator ensures efficient operation for the College of Health Professions by providing administrative and project management support for the college and programs, including clinical operations and contract management support for programs and the Dean. This role will include coordination of activities with other departments or programs, administrative support to faculty and staff, HR related activities, data collection and review, preparation of reports, committee work, student support, updating of web pages and catalog sections, event and meeting coordination, etc. This requires interaction with Evidence in Motion to manage and obtain signatures on affiliation agreements for programs within the College of Health Professions, including certificates of liability. This is an active role, which involves dealing with a wide range of matters, sometimes of a confidential nature and requires attention to detail, organization, interpersonal and communication skills. The coordinator must be able to multitask and prioritize effectively, work with tight deadlines, and learn new systems and procedures rapidly.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Dean Support**

* Manage the calendar of the Dean.
* Support the Dean in the management \& completion of various University processes to agreed deadlines.
* Reports on status of college, departmental and University projects.
* Coordinates meeting requests with internal and external entities.
* Records minutes for meetings conducted by the Dean, Program Dean/Director.
* Works with the Dean/Directors to prepare and track all business transactions pertinent to the college activity including purchase orders (PO), check requests, and Memoranda of Understanding (MOU).
* Completes all clinical education affiliation agreement routing for the College of Health Professions through SCU internal offices for review and signature.
* Enters and manages clinical education agreements within EXXAT database.
* Works directly with the Evidence in Motion Clinical Operations team to manage clinical education processes and agreements.
* Plans, organizes, and coordinates travel arrangements for the Dean.
* Provides support for all program accreditations.
* Assists in the development of the annual budget, monitors college budget expenditures, creates reports as needed.
* Acts as liaison between Dean/Director and faculty, staff, students, University departments, and outside agencies and organizations.
* Coordinates special projects and events as needed.
* Utilizes feedback to improve college processes.

**Faculty Support**

* Ensures faculty data is complete and accurate in all databases and platforms.
* Coordinates and monitors attendance and grade submission to meet university deadlines.
* Supports the directors of clinical education and academic fieldwork coordinators in clinical education agreement management and signature procurement.

**College Support**

* Responsible for the coordination/completion and the quality of the clerical work for the college.
* Performs and coordinates scheduling tasks and support services associated with preparing and making arrangements for and assisting with on\-campus events, meetings, conferences, travel, or other related duties.
* Represents the college at events such as orientation, first day of classes, graduation and other ceremonies, symposia, examination weeks, etc.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Assists in the preparation of status and technical reports and documents (Accreditation, book adoptions, student rosters, etc.).
* Maintains confidential records and files (paper and electronic).
* Monitors and maintains an inventory of durable and non\-durable inventory, supplies, and capital equipment, monitors functionality and expiration dates and plans for equipment replacement.
* Assist with purchasing requirements including obtaining vendor price quotes, requisitions for purchase, initiates and communicates with the purchasing department.
* Monitors for accuracy and updates portions of the academic catalog (Acalog), handbooks, website, MySCU, faculty/staff email lists, and other publications.
* Coordinates curriculum revision projects and ensures accuracy of data in course information systems (Canvas, Curriculog, J1\).
* Assists in managing and updating academic platforms and databases such as Canvas, J1, Teams, MySCU, ExamSoft, Interfolio, Curriculog, Electronic Student Academic Records, and program specific databases.
* Monitors and guides the completion of college projects and assignments.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Coordinates the development of annual and term program and examination schedules, faculty and room assignments, and inputs data into schedule management system (Coursedog).
* Informs faculty, staff, and students of changes in the schedule; manages all processes related to the changes in courses offered in a term.
* Provides information related to university and college policies, processes, and deadlines, and directs individuals to sources of additional information.
* Maintains college book lists and coordinates updates through the curriculum management system
* (Curriculog), compliance reports, and communication with the LRC.

jobs.title: Health Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Healthcare Staffing Professionals has an immediate need for a Health Program Coordinator. HPC duties must comply with established Department of Public Health (DPH) policies procedures, state and local laws, ordinances, and regulations for the control of communicable disease. HPC must maintain client confidentiality requirement per the Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act (HIPAA). In addition, staff must adhere to LAC DPH, and Protected Health Information, procedure, policies, and ordinance pertaining to HIV Security and Confidentiality laws and trainings.



The Division of HIV and STD Programs (DHSP) Health Program Coordinator (HPC) plans, coordinates, and implements public health programming by providing direct services in the field, developing and monitoring management and logistical processes, assists Public Health Investigators (PHIs) for the control of communicable diseases with special focus on HIV and STIs. Assignments may include but not limited to linking clients to HIV care and syphilis treatment, conducting specialized CDR interviews with clients, transporting clients to high priority medical appointments, conducting chart reviews, providing Field Delivered Therapy (FDT), collaborating with other Direct Community Services (DCS) programs to implement field based/mobile testing services. The HPC supports data management efforts including data entry, data quality assurance, analyzing HIV and syphilis labs, and collaborating with surveillance units. The HPC will lead planning and logistics for outreach events for special initiatives and DCS programs.



The positions will start immediately upon acceptance and employment clearance and are initially funded through 8/31/27, with the good chance of extension.


**Pay Rate:** $30\.24/hr working 40 hours a week


**Location**: Hybrid 2 days a week in office. Telework/Field works the remaining days.


**Benefits**: Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Time, PTO


**Healthcare**: Employer Fully Funded Healthcare (Anthem Blue Cross), Dental and Vision, Life Insurance from Initial


**Job Duties:**

* Activities include but are not limited to conducting linkage to care, treatment, biomedical prevention, or other essential services for priority clients/contacts; conduct Cluster Detection and Response (CDR) enhanced re\-interviews; support case investigation and documentation; analyze HIV and STI case information to develop and implement timely disease intervention plans; complete treatment verification and chart reviews; counsel and educate clients on risk\-reduction and prevention strategies; provide FDT and other supplies such as self\-test kits, condoms, harm reduction items.
* Develop tracking plans, service reports, and scopes of work to ensure goals are met.
* Coordinate outreach activities to support DCS program efforts. Lead logistical activities to prepare and report event outcomes. Support testing events as the mobile unit driver, on\-site coordinator, working with venue partners.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.


**Qualifications:**

* Four years of experience in planning and implementing organized community programs and activities in public or community health, delinquency prevention, community relations, or community welfare. Graduation from an accredited college or university with a degree in public health will be accepted for one year of the required experience.
* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Thorough knowledge of HIV and STI testing, biomedical prevention, and treatment protocols.
* Knowledge of HIV/STI, drug treatment, mental health, housing service programs.
* Ability to complete HIV/STI counseling and testing training and certification.
* Knowledge of and experience with HIV/STI labs, data, data systems, and quality assurance standards.
* Strong outreach skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills (verbal and written).
* Knowledge with Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, Power\-point, and ability to learn internal data systems.
* Able to participate in field\-based services.
* **Preferable**: Bilingual Spanish

jobs.title: Research Program Specialist
jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, please attached a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

**Position Description**


The Schaeffer Institute is seeking a **Research Program Specialist** to provide high\-level administrative leadership for the USC Mann Department of Pharmaceutical \& Health Economics, and to take on new programmatic support for the Institute leadership team and its growing modeling research program. Working with established and up\-and\-coming scholars, the **Research Program Specialist** will develop and spearhead new procedures and processes to support an in\-demand research team and their work with sophisticated data and modeling tools developed at the Institute. The **Research Program Specialist** will assist in program development and ensure that deadlines and milestones are met. The position will report to the Schaeffer Institute Director of Operations (in coordination with respective departmental leadership), who will help oversee the portfolio of work and ensure a collaborative and creative work environment across teams. The right candidate will contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape priorities to ensure leadership and program success.


This position offers a unique opportunity in the substantive work of a policy research center and an important academic department. The right candidate will have administrative expertise, high attention to detail, and enthusiasm for supporting a robust research agenda, faculty activities, and student engagement. The Schaeffer Institute serves a varied group of internal and external constituents—including students, academics, executives, philanthropists, and leading policymakers and staffers—across the political spectrum. Demonstrated experience working with leading faculty and scholars to support research goals is a plus.

**Research Program Leadership**

* Coordinate administrative functions for the modeling research program and other research initiatives as directed by Schaeffer leadership, including acting as a point of contact, responding to requests and inquiries, and managing program content.
* Assist program leadership and key stakeholders with anaylsis, research, and presentations.
* Manage program deadlines; coordinating and tracking grants, projects, and timelines to ensure deliverables and milestones are met.
* Support reporting and proposal development, including budget tracking, grant submissions, and compliance processes.
* Coordinate and contribute to research studies, proposals, and grant\-related research activities.
* Contribute to administrative leadership team meetings and support to Schaeffer academic and policy programming as time allows.

**Department Leadership**

* Oversee Department Chair’s administrative duties by managing calendars, coordinating meetings, preparing course materials, and assisting with day\-to\-day departmental operations for leading faculty.
* Organize departmental events, including conferences, seminars, special events and faculty meetings by managing logistics, vendor communications, facilities, catering, guest accommodations, and event execution.

jobs.title: Account Manager / Permit Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About National Permit Group**

National Permit Group is a full\-service permit and planning firm based in West Hollywood, CA, helping residential and commercial clients get their projects approved and permitted — primarily throughout Southern California, with additional projects in other states. We work with homeowners, developers, contractors, and property owners — and because we have an in\-house design team preparing architectural plans, we're able to offer clients a complete path from design through permit issuance.

Getting a project approved isn't just paperwork — it's a relationship business. Plans sit with city reviewers, questions come back, engineers need to weigh in, clients want to know what's actually happening. We're looking for someone who can own that relationship on all sides: the client who wants answers, and the city officials, plan checkers, and engineers who have them.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an **Account Manager / Permit Coordinator** to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and everyone involved in getting their project permitted — city planning and building departments, plan checkers, permit techs, structural engineers, and contractors. This is not a data\-entry or paperwork\-routing role. It's a relationship and advocacy role: you're the person who knows the status of every project, knows who to call when something stalls, and knows how to ask the right question to get it moving.

What You'll Do

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the main point of contact for residential homeowners and corporate clients (retail, restaurant, hospitality) throughout their project's permitting process
* Proactively communicate project status to clients with specifics — current stage, what's driving any delay, and the next concrete step — rather than a generic "still pending"
* Send plans to clients for review and approval, and manage their feedback
* Respond to client emails and calls promptly and knowledgeably

**City \& Agency Coordination**

* Communicate directly with city and county building/planning departments, plan checkers, permit techs, and officials
* Push each project forward by asking the right questions of reviewers and officials — identifying who's responsible, what's causing a delay, and when escalation is warranted — rather than passively waiting on a response
* Make submittals and pick up/drop off plans at city building and planning departments as needed
* Upload and download plans and corrections through city and agency portals
* Manage the issuance of permits once approvals are complete

**Project Coordination**

* Track every project's status in Trello, including when corrections come back and when plans are sent to the structural engineer
* Coordinate with our in\-house design team, structural engineers, and outside contractors to keep projects moving
* Flag risks or delays before they become client\-facing problems

**Administrative Support (light)**

* Keep project files and portal access organized
* Occasional coordination of ownership calendar/meetings related to client projects

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a client\-facing coordination role — account management, client services, project coordination, or similar — ideally in construction, architecture, real estate development, or a related field
* Comfort being persistent and assertive with government offices and third parties on a client's behalf
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical/process status in plain language to clients
* Highly organized and able to track multiple projects at different stages simultaneously
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (occasional travel to city offices and project sites)

*Preferred*

* Experience with permit processing, plan checking, or municipal approval processes
* Familiarity with Trello or similar project\-tracking tools
* Background or coursework in architecture, urban planning, or construction management
* Existing relationships with Southern California city planning/building departments

**What Makes You Successful**

* You take ownership of a project rather than waiting to be told what's next
* You're comfortable pushing back and escalating — professionally — when something isn't moving
* You can hold a lot of moving pieces in your head (or your Trello board) without dropping them
* You're as comfortable talking to a homeowner as you are to a plan checker
* You like being the person who actually knows what's going on

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II
jobs.description:
Job Title: Clinical Research Coordinator II


Reports to: Research Regulatory/QC Manager


Location: Sherman Oaks and Travel within Greater Los Angeles, CA

  

Job Summary


The Clinical Research Coordinator II is a critical, high\-autonomy role that makes clinical research accessible to our patient population while providing administrative support to the clinic. Working on behalf of the Principal Investigator (PI), this individual independently manages the full study lifecycle—from feasibility and start\-up, through patient recruitment, eligibility assessment, and follow\-up, to the preparation and gathering of all data and documents for this highly regulated process. This role is best suited to a coordinator who has run trials with significant independence at a smaller or independent site, is comfortable owning multiple functions at once, and can train and mentor less experienced coordinators as our research program grows.

  

Major Duties \& Responsibilities


Research

* Works with PI to meet or exceed study enrollment as per Sponsor’s inclusion/exclusion criteria
* Complete feasibility questionnaires based on site information and all regulatory start up packages
* Recruits and enrolls patents in a friendly and professional manner, screening for eligibility criteria
* Conducts patient visit, collects all required data in appropriate formats, and follows up with all subjects as appropriate
* Reports, tracks and follows up on an all adverse events, protocol waivers, deviations and violations
* Complies with all study protocol, SOP and reporting requirements in a timely manner
* Responsible for completion of all required documentation with keen focus on the integrity of the data submitted by careful source document review, monitoring for missing data and/or inconsistencies.
* Maintains thorough and accurate records per regulatory/compliance standards at all times including but not limited to data for potential inspection; signed informed consents, source documentation, drug dispensing logs, subject logs, and all study related communication
* Creates study specific tools for source documentation when not provided by sponsor
* Collects, completes and enters data into study specific forms and/or electronic data capture system
* Appropriately handles and records all specimens; prepares specimens for shipment; tracks all shipments; tracks all inventory and calibrations.
* Attends relevant meetings (e.g. SIVs, PSSVs, IMVs, COVs, audits); assists Sponsor and FDA with any audits and responds to any monitoring/audit findings
* Actively communicate with stakeholders as appropriate (Sponsor, IRB, vendors) and maintain active communication on status of each study with PI and management as directed
* Trains, mentors, and provides day\-to\-day guidance to less experienced coordinators and clinic staff on research processes, GCP, and site systems; serves as a point of escalation for research\-related questions
* Independently owns day\-to\-day research operations for the site with minimal oversight, exercising sound judgment to prioritize competing study demands

  

Other

* Works in clinic to operate clinic cleanly, safely and efficiently
* Prepares exam and treatment rooms per cleaning protocols; assists with all processes (within scope of certification) to maintain inventory of supplies, medication, and equipment necessary for the operation of the clinic.
* Keys data into EMR/forms to maintain accurate office and patient records
* Organizes tasks to facilitate smooth work/patient flow
* Schedules and registers patients; referrals to specialists as appropriate
* Handles routine administrative tasks (filing, correspondence, mail) as needed to support clinic operations
* Adheres to all company policies and procedures, business conduct and work compliance standards
* Will be required to travel and work at multiple clinics within a reasonable driving distance from home clinic
* Any other task reasonably requested by company to meet its goals

  

Job Related Skills/Competencies

* Effective use of computerized patient care system
* Knowledge of medical terminology
* Knowledge of all safety requirements when handling biohazardous specimens or contaminated instruments
* Strong interpersonal skills to interact with patients, families, ancillary departments, physicians and co\-workers in a courteous and compassionate manner
* Strong, courteous and professional verbal skills to effectively convey sensitive information in a courteous manner in person or on the telephone; effective written communication and computer skills for proper charting
* Ability to work well under pressure and be quick on your feet
* Has a contagious and positive work ethic; models our core values
* An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments
* Proficient use of EMR and CTMS systems and ability to effectively use our systems within 2 weeks
* Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and provide constructive feedback to less experienced coordinators
* Ability to independently manage multiple studies and competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal supervision, consistent with experience at a smaller or independent site
* Proficient use of Microsoft (e.g. Office, Excel, Word)

  

Education/Qualifications

* High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree in a health science or related field preferred
* Minimum of 2\-3 years of clinical research coordinator experience at an investigational site required, with solid knowledge of clinical trials terminology, processes, forms and reporting
* Experience at a smaller or independent site network, with broad ownership across regulatory, recruitment, data, and monitoring\-visit functions, strongly preferred
* Prior experience training, onboarding, or mentoring other coordinators preferred
* Certification (e.g. CCRC via ACRP or CCRP via SOCRA) a plus
* Phlebotomy certificate preferred
* Current Medi\-Waste Training for: Blo

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on demand planning, production scheduling, and category management to align inventory levels with forecasted demand.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience practicing in a supply chain operations or logistics role with a strong understanding of warehouse management, transportation planning, and materials handling.
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as AS400 or SAP, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Inventory Management Systems (IMS), and transportation management systems (TMS).
* Strong data analysis skills using Excel (including data collection and analysis), SQL, Tableau or similar tools for supply chain analytics.
* Knowledge of international trade regulations, trade compliance standards, and NVOCC (Non\-Vessel Operating Common Carrier) operations.

$21–$25 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio quality.

SALES REPRESENTATIVE / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENTElite Home Staging \| Southern California

**Elite Home Staging is growing—and we are looking for a driven, relationship\-focused Sales Representative to help us bring in new business.**

If you are a **natural salesperson who loves real estate, luxury homes, interiors, and design**, this is an opportunity to turn those interests into a rewarding career with one of Southern California’s leading home\-staging companies.

ABOUT ELITE HOME STAGING

Elite Home Staging is the **third\-largest home\-staging company in Southern California**, with more than **200 homes across the Los Angeles market**. We specialize in beautifully designed staging for luxury properties and work closely with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and homeowners to help properties make a powerful first impression and sell successfully.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an energetic **Sales Representative / Business Development professional** whose primary responsibility will be to **generate new clients and grow Elite Home Staging's business**.

This is a highly relationship\-driven sales position. You will be responsible for building a strong network within the real estate community, identifying potential clients, developing relationships, following up consistently, and converting opportunities into new staging business.

You will have the opportunity to work directly with **top\-producing real estate agents, luxury brokers, developers, and other industry professionals** throughout Southern California.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Prospect and generate new business through **cold outreach, networking, office visits, referrals, events, and relationship building**
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with real estate agents, brokers, developers, builders, and other potential referral partners
* Regularly visit real estate offices and meet with agents to introduce Elite Home Staging
* Identify high\-value sales opportunities and turn prospects into long\-term clients
* Follow up with leads consistently and strategically
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline
* Schedule consultations, presentations, and property appointments
* Present Elite Home Staging's services with confidence and professionalism
* Educate prospective clients on the value of professional staging
* Stay informed about the local real estate market and identify opportunities for growth
* Represent Elite Home Staging at networking events, broker events, open houses, and industry functions
* Work closely with our design and operations teams to ensure a seamless client experience
* Maintain ongoing relationships with existing clients while continuously pursuing new business

DESIGN INTEREST IS A MAJOR PLUS

You **do not need to be an interior designer**, but you should have a genuine interest in **interior design, furniture, architecture, luxury homes, and current design trends**.

The ideal candidate understands that selling staging is about more than selling furniture—it is about helping agents and homeowners **position a property, create an emotional connection with buyers, and maximize the property's presentation.**

Your design eye will help you speak confidently with clients and understand what makes a home marketable.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly motivated and sales\-driven**
* Confident, outgoing, and comfortable meeting new people
* A strong communicator and relationship builder
* Comfortable with cold calling and prospecting
* Persistent and excellent at follow\-up
* Professional and polished when interacting with luxury clientele
* Goal\-oriented and motivated by earning potential
* Organized and able to manage multiple prospects and opportunities
* Passionate about real estate, interiors, and design
* Comfortable presenting and selling services
* A self\-starter who can work independently
* Someone who genuinely enjoys networking and making connections

THE IDEAL BACKGROUND

Experience in **real estate, home staging, interior design, furniture, luxury sales, hospitality, recruiting, or business development** is a plus.

However, **we are more interested in your sales ability, personality, work ethic, and drive than a specific background.**

If you are someone who can walk into a real estate office, confidently introduce yourself, start a conversation with an agent, build a relationship, and ultimately turn that relationship into business—you may be exactly who we're looking for.

COMPENSATION \& OPPORTUNITY

This position offers a **competitive compensation structure with commission and significant earning potential based on sales performance.**

The opportunity is ideal for someone who wants their income to reflect their effort and success.

WHY ELITE HOME STAGING?

* Work with a recognized leader in Southern California's home\-staging industry
* Build relationships with **high\-producing real estate professionals**
* Work around luxury homes and beautiful interiors
* Opportunity for significant commission and sales growth
* Be part of a creative, fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment
* Build a valuable network within the Southern California real estate industry
* Grow with an established and expanding company

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are **a salesperson at heart, love design and real estate, and are hungry to build a book of business**, we want to hear from you.

**Elite Home Staging is looking for someone who doesn't wait for business to come to them—they go out and create it.**

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90001

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager – US Market
jobs.description:
**Travel:** Approximately 20–30%  
**Employment:** Full\-Time

About Xcotton

**Xcotton is building the next generation of post\-purchase protection for global e\-commerce brands.**

We provide embedded insurance and protection solutions for DTC and cross\-border merchants, including **Shipping Protection, Return Assurance, and Extended Warranty**, integrated directly into checkout through Shopify and other e\-commerce platforms.

Xcotton is licensed across the **U.S., Hong Kong, China, France, and the UK**, is part of **Shouhui Group**, a Hong Kong publicly listed company, and is backed by **AIG**.

Our advantage is simple: **compliance\-first, API\-first, and built specifically for modern DTC and cross\-border brands.**

The Opportunity

We’re looking for our **first U.S. Customer Success Manager** to help build and shape Xcotton’s customer success function in the U.S.

This is not a traditional support role.

You’ll own relationships with key e\-commerce merchants after the sale—from onboarding and implementation to retention, expansion, and renewal. You’ll work directly with merchant decision\-makers while partnering internally with Product, Underwriting, Sales, and Operations.

For someone who enjoys **building relationships, solving problems, working with data, and helping customers grow**, this is an opportunity to have real ownership at an early stage of our U.S. expansion.

What You’ll Do

* **Own key merchant relationships** — Serve as the primary post\-sales partner for key accounts and build trusted, long\-term relationships.
* **Lead onboarding \& implementation** — Guide new merchants through integration, setup, launch, and training.
* **Drive retention \& expansion** — Identify renewal, upsell, and cross\-sell opportunities while proactively reducing churn risk.
* **Run business reviews** — Use performance data and merchant insights to lead regular business reviews and recommend opportunities for growth.
* **Monitor account health** — Track adoption, performance, merchant satisfaction, and potential churn signals.
* **Be the voice of the customer** — Bring merchant feedback and market insights back to our Product, Underwriting, Sales, and Operations teams.
* **Help build the function** — As our first U.S. Customer Success hire, you’ll help shape processes, playbooks, reporting, and the overall customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in **Customer Success, Account Management, Strategic Accounts, or a similar client\-facing role**
* Experience working in **e\-commerce, SaaS, logistics, fintech, insurtech, or related industries**
* Experience managing **mid\-market, enterprise, or key merchant accounts**
* Strong relationship\-building, communication, and project management skills
* Comfortable using data to identify account opportunities and risks
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects independently
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **shipping protection, returns, warranties, embedded insurance, or post\-purchase solutions**
* Familiarity with **Shopify and the DTC e\-commerce ecosystem**
* Experience working with cross\-border brands
* Experience working across **U.S. and Asian markets or teams**
* Experience joining an early\-stage U.S. team or helping build a Customer Success function

Compensation \& Benefits

**Base Salary:** $85,000–$120,000  
**Target Bonus:** $10,000–$25,000\+ based on retention and expansion performance  
**OTE:** $95,000–$145,000\+  
**Equity:** Stock option package available

**Benefits include:**

* Medical, Dental \& Vision
* 401(k) match
* Home office stipend
* Flexible PTO
* Remote\-first work environment
* Travel opportunities
* Direct exposure to U.S. and global leadership

*Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and location.*

Why Join Xcotton?

**Build, don’t just maintain.**  
You’ll be our first U.S. Customer Success hire and have a meaningful voice in how the function is built.

**Work with fast\-growing e\-commerce brands.**  
You’ll partner directly with DTC and cross\-border merchants and help them improve their post\-purchase experience.

**Strong foundation, startup\-level ownership.**  
Xcotton combines the speed and ownership of a growing U.S. business with the backing of an established public parent company and AIG.

**Your impact is measurable.**  
Your work directly influences merchant retention, expansion, customer experience, and Xcotton’s U.S. growth.

**Remote\-first with real ownership.**  
Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying close to merchants and the leadership team.

Ready to Build With Us?

If you’re excited about **e\-commerce, customer success, and building something from the ground up**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help shape Xcotton’s customer experience in the U.S.**

Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Orange, CA 92866

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.


Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

**What We're Looking For**

The James Irvine Foundation is a private, nonprofit grantmaking foundation dedicated to expanding opportunity for the people of California. The Foundation’s current focus is a California where all low\-income workers have the power to advance economically. Since 1937 the Foundation has provided more than $2\.92 billion in grants to organizations throughout California. The Foundation ended 2025 with $3\.6 billion in assets and provided $160\.2 million in grants. For more, please visit www.irvine.org.  

  

**About the Role \- Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator**  

The Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator will play a critical role in ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations in our San Francisco office and provides administrative, clerical, and project‐related support to key operations and program areas. This role will be centrally positioned to learn about and influence all aspects of an impactful \& innovative foundation.  

  

You are someone who works well with a team and independently; have exemplary organizational skills with the ability to multi\-task and respond to rapidly changing priorities; and have superior interpersonal skills, high self\-awareness, and sound judgment.  

  

The Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator will have a high level of integrity, exceptional character, confidence, and the ability to remain calm in stressful situations. We are looking for a problem solver with excellent time management and prioritization skills, who is a passionate self\-motivator.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**  

Facilities Management* Supports staff with use of all office equipment and ensures that machines have adequate supplies. Serves as a central contact for troubleshooting and repair requests of all office equipment.
* Prepares and maintains files on all office equipment, appliances, furniture, and supplies, including all warranties and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinates and oversees all cleaning, repairs, and facility\-related services.
* Manages office supply orders and organizes storage closets.
* Assists the IT Department with on‐site troubleshooting and provides general support.
* Answers telephone calls and directs callers to individual staff members.
* Processes incoming and outgoing mail and faxes.
* Serves as liaison to the building management in the San Francisco office for day‐to‐day matters and provides office keys and access cards to staff as needed.
* Attends all safety and emergency training sessions offered by the building and informs staff and others using Foundation facilities about safety and emergency procedures. Manages the floor warden program and coordinates the activities of floor warden volunteers.
* Maintains kitchen, prepares coffee, orders, organizes, and stocks kitchen supplies.
* Coordinates with any caterers being brought in, including obtaining certificates of insurance and facilitating building access.


General Administration* Provides logistical support for medium/large group meetings onsite.
* For on‐site meetings, independently partner with other support staff (i.e., IT, Accounting, EAs, PAs, POs, etc.).
* Provides support to Program Associates and EAs during the planning, preparation, or managing of convenings onsite.
* Routinely attends Facilities and Administration team meetings and maintains a thorough working knowledge of the priorities for the operations and initiative areas of the Foundation.
* Maintains subscriptions to journals and other publications.

**Who you are:*** **A Team Player:** Nothing is beneath or above you. You are quick to always lend a hand, or two! You are able to earn influence without authority and naturally seek to support both small projects and large strategic goals.
* **Resourceful and Adaptable:** You're at ease with ambiguity and rapid change. You possess a positive attitude and identify creative solutions to obstacles. You can juggle many essential responsibilities at once, and you're rigorous about prioritizing.

You can easily gain trust from team members and are known for supporting them to ensure they are set up for success. You’re not afraid to ask questions.

* **Emotionally Intelligent:** You are self\-aware and perceptive. You nurture relationships and can work and communicate well with all kinds of people. You are optimistic, empathetic, flexible, curious, and well\-respected by all who work with you, irrespective of title.

  

**What you'll need*** 3\+ years of professional experience (we are background agnostic and are excited by candidates with unique and different work histories).

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (San Francisco, CA)**  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to **25 Residents**. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Compensation**

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $65k \- $100k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20\-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today.** The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

 **Requirements**  

  

Required Qualifications:* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without need for sponsorship


Preferred Qualifications:* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer\-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal\-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2\-week bootcamp
* Strong communication skills
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high\-performance environment

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2\-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3\-month residency with an employer partner
* Hybrid work environment
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers

Rexel USA is one of the largest distributors of electrical products, data communication, wireless communication and related supplies in the United States. Rexel USA operates its electrical distribution business in the United States through eight Regions that go to market under various banner and trade names, including Rexel, Rexel Automation, Gexpro, Mayer, Talley and Platt Electric Supply. In addition to an online store, Rexel USA has a distribution network of over 460 warehouse storefront locations throughout the U.S.

 **Job Description** **We are looking for an Outside Sales Representative to join our Rexel USA team in San Francisco, CA!**

 **Summary:**  

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for the sales and marketing efforts with the objective of increased profitable sales through creating, building, and maintaining high quality relationships with new and existing customers. Utilize company digital tools and company products and services to connect with consumers, develop creative solutions, generate sales volume, and provide the highest level of customer service.  

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for selling, marketing, promoting, and demonstrating products. Effectively communicate the features and benefits of our product offering

Participate in company training/development, special promotions, sales meetings, supplier seminars, and training schools to enhance and maintain personal and product knowledge

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cancer Center (Berkeley/Burlingame)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

***\*\*This position requires flexibility to work across various UCSF Medical Center locations, including UCSF Cancer Center in Berkeley and Burlingame.*** *\*\**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) Clinical Research Network Office is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to support the clinical research programs at our UCSF partner sites. The CRC will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager (CRM), Operations Manager, and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF, and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, and assist the CRM and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Institutional Review Board online systems, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


**Department Summary:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences
* Experience with various computer program (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day; may need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle; ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of federal, state, and local research; regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to apply relevant information to the assessment, required interpretation, and processing of medical data
Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team\-oriented environment  
* 

Preferred Qualifications:


* Fluency in the usage of IRB online system, iRIS, for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of location specific and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing / shipping infectious substance

Full time

Hybrid

Human Resources

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high\-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co\-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator - San Francisco
jobs.description:
At HOKALI, we simplify how schools book, organize, and manage after\-school programs and camps. Our platform helps schools find and book a wide variety of onsite programs to supplement learning and enrich students' extracurricular experiences. We believe every child deserves the opportunity to explore their interests and reach their full potential.


About the Role
We are looking for a detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator (Part\-Time)** to oversee our inventory, material distribution, and site supply operations. In this role, you will manage gear, uniforms, and educational supplies from receipt to final site delivery across the SF Bay Area.


You will be responsible for receiving shipments, maintaining an organized storage facility, building program packages, and ensuring all materials reach our partner school sites efficiently.


Key Responsibilities* Inventory \& Storage Management: Receive, inspect, organize, and properly label all incoming inventory, program materials, and staff uniforms at our central storage facility.
* Stock Tracking \& Records: Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date inventory records and log all incoming/outgoing items.
* Kitting \& Package Assembly: Assemble, pack, and prepare welcome kits, uniforms, and site\-specific material packages according to program needs.
* Distribution \& Shipping: Coordinate shipments via carriers (UPS/FedEx) or personally deliver supplies directly to partner school sites as needed.
* Regional Logistics Coverage: Manage supply operations across the SF Bay Area / Oakland, with scheduled site/storage visits to San Jose approximately once per month.
* Internal Communication: Coordinate closely with operations teams via Slack and track hours using TriNet.


Schedule \& Compensation* Type: Part\-Time (Flexibility based on weekly operational volume).
* Schedule: Estimated 4–8 hours per week (flexible scheduling).
* Compensation: $28 – $32 / hour \+ Mileage Reimbursement for personal vehicle usage (or $35 / hour flat rate inclusive of travel).
* Locations: SF Bay Area / Oakland (with monthly travel to San Jose).

 **Requirements**  

* Reliable Personal Vehicle (Required): Must have a valid driver’s license, active auto insurance, and a clean driving record to transport and deliver materials/boxes between sites.
* Physical Capability: Ability to lift, carry, and move boxes and equipment weighing up to 40 lbs.
* Prior experience in warehouse management, inventory control, or field logistics preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and high attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain organized records.
* Proficiency with digital tools (Slack, spreadsheets, shipping platforms).

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation.
* Flexible scheduling aligned with your availability and operational needs.
* Access to the HOKALI Academy—a community space designed for educators to learn, connect, and collaborate.
* Structured lesson plans provided, with room to bring your own creative ideas to class.
* Opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities within HOKALI.
* Employee Referral Program with bonus incentives.
