jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Generalist**
====================


At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done.


We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world.


The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness).


We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

### **About the Role**


At Generalist, we build foundation models for the physical world. Across our team in San Mateo and Boston, we know that our company’s future is shaped entirely by the people who join us. That’s why we care deeply about making every candidate feel welcomed, valued, and respected from their very first conversation to their very first day on the job.


As our Recruiting Coordinator, you’ll be the heart of that candidate experience!


You will serve as our operational anchor, bringing warmth, organization, and clarity to interview scheduling, candidate communication, and overall hiring logistics. Sitting at the intersection of every team at Generalist, you'll play a vital role in building our culture and company.


You will be in the San Mateo office five days a week.

**Here’s what you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the scheduling of all interview stages — from initial chats and screens to full on\-sites — across San Mateo, Boston, and candidate time zones using Ashby.
* Be the main guide and friendly contact for candidates throughout their journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels thoughtful, well\-organized, and seamless.
* Coordinate travel and expenses for visiting candidates, ensuring flights, hotel stays, ground transit, and reimbursements are effortless for them.
* Keep Ashby running smoothly and reliably — maintaining stage accuracy, interview plans, email templates, direct\-booking links, and interviewer training records.
* Support interviewer balance across our team by distributing schedules fairly and flagging early when we need to expand our interviewer pool.
* Keep pipelines flowing effortlessly by spotting potential bottlenecks, resolving delays, and troubleshooting scheduling conflicts proactively.
* Partner on offer logistics — from background checks and Ashby offer packets to sending personalized welcome notes and swag — ensuring a delightful handoff to HR and IT for day one.
* Treat candidate privacy with utmost care and discretion at every step of the process.
* Continuously refine our recruiting tools, templates, and workflows to make our interview operations increasingly efficient and candidate\-friendly.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 1\+ year(s) coordinating interviews at volume, or comparable experience — an EA supporting several executives, or an operations role where you owned complex multi\-party scheduling and the consequences of getting it wrong.
* Have worked in Ashby and know its scheduling, interview plans, templates, and interviewer pools well enough to have opinions about how they should be set up.
* Write unusually well in short forms. A reschedule email from you makes a candidate feel taken care of rather than processed, and a note to a hiring manager tells them exactly what you need in three lines.
* Are precise by disposition. Names spelled correctly, links tested before they are sent, time zones right the first time, and no interview that starts with five minutes of confusion.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly when schedules shift, candidates re\-route, or hiring needs change.
* Genuine customer service orientation – you treat every candidate, hiring manager, and interviewer like the most important person in your inbox.
* Interest in a long\-term career in People, Talent, or HR – with curiosity about how recruiting operations scale as a company grows.
* Are energized by being in the office five days a week and want to be in the room on the days that matter.

jobs.title: Lead Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to provide strategic and operational support to the Chief Administrative Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and General Counsel. This role is central to driving operational excellence, fostering company culture, and enabling strategic decision\-making across OpenGov's executive leadership team.


The ideal candidate will be a proactive, culturally\-attuned partner who excels at managing complex executive priorities while serving as a cultural bridge across the organization. You'll coordinate high\-impact events, offsites, and initiatives that strengthen OpenGov's culture and engagement, while simultaneously managing the sophisticated logistics of supporting three senior executives in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.


This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to amplify impact beyond traditional admin work. You'll be instrumental in shaping how leadership connects with the organization, how key decisions get made, and how our people experience OpenGov's values.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------


Executive Support \& Strategic Partnership

* Multi\-Executive Calendar \& Inbox Management: Proactively manage complex calendars for the CAO, CFO, and GC across multiple time zones and business priorities. Anticipate scheduling conflicts, suggest trade\-offs, and block time strategically to protect focus on highest\-impact work.
* Executive Coordination \& Alignment: Serve as a key connective node between the three executives and across organizational departments. Facilitate seamless communication, flag misalignments early, and help drive execution on shared priorities.
* Meeting Preparation \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive briefing materials, agendas and presentations for team meetings. Take detailed notes during key discussions, clearly document action items with owners and deadlines, and ensure follow\-through on commitments.
* Travel Management: Plan domestic and international travel itineraries for executives and leadership team. Handle logistics including accommodations, ground transportation, visa coordination, and real\-time adjustments. Leverage AI tools to optimize travel planning and expense reporting.
* Process Optimization \& Documentation: Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes (meeting cadences, approvals, communications). Document processes and maintain operational playbooks that scale as the company grows.


Culture \& Events Leadership


Culture Events \& Execution: Help support company all hands meetings, happy hours and other internal events, working cross functionally with partners in Workplace and HR.

* Offsite Management: Lead the planning and execution of team offsites. This may include venue selection, agenda design and logistics coordination. Create experiences that foster strategic thinking, team building, and culture reinforcement.
* Cultural Listening \& Insight: Maintain a pulse on team engagement and culture through informal connections across the organization. Bring observations and insights to leadership about what's resonating, what needs attention, and how to strengthen culture.


AI \& Modern Tools Leadership

* AI Tool Adoption and Workflow Innovation: Actively explore and pilot AI\-powered tools to enhance team productivity. Examples: scheduling automation, meeting transcription and summarization, email drafting assistance, presentation generation, and workflow optimization.
* Best Practices Sharing: Stay informed on emerging AI and automation trends and share insights with the broader admin team.

  

**Key Attributes \& Competencies**
----------------------------------


Strategic Mindset

* Understands the business context behind decisions and initiatives
* Anticipates needs before they're asked for
* Thinks beyond the immediate task to broader impact


Cultural Intelligence \& EQ

* High emotional intelligence with ability to build trust and read the room across all levels of the organization
* Balances professionalism with warmth; demonstrates OpenGov values in daily interactions


Operational Excellence

* Obsessive attention to detail while managing high complexity
* Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
* Strong time management and ability to juggle competing priorities


Communication \& Influence

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to distill complex information into clear executive summaries
* Comfortable communicating with executives, boards, and employees


Judgment \& Discretion

* Trustworthy with confidential and sensitive information
* Demonstrates good judgment about what needs escalation vs. what you can handle independently
* Maintains objectivity and professionalism in complex situations


Learning Agility \& Curiosity

* Quick learner who becomes fluent in OpenGov's business, products, and culture
* Intellectually curious about how organizations work and how to make them work better
* Comfortable with technology and eager to learn new tools

**Requirements \& Preferred Experience**
--------------------------------

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager, Special Projects, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


**Position Description:**

**This role will be based in Santa Clara California, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

* Vantage is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to assist the Special Projects team and Project Managers to drive success on new and ongoing construction projects.
* The position covers all aspects of a construction project. Areas of expertise that require minimal oversight and autonomy in the following areas:
* RFP development and overall project budgeting
* Pre\-bid oversight and coordination assistance
* Assist managing all design phases and documents
* Assist managing, coordinating and supervising design\-build contractors and vendors
* Assist and/or coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Assist with oversight of physical construction activities
* Participation in commissioning
* Assist, manage and own project close outs: Punch list, as\-builds, warranties, OEM, etc.
**Essential Job Functions:**

* Report to and assist Vantage Special Projects team and assigned manager.
* Proficient at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
* Gather vendor proposals, invoicing documents and ensure vendor deliverables are delivered in a timely manner.
* Manage individual tasks throughout the construction process including submittals, RFI process, drawings and safety reporting.
* Proficient understanding of contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, etc.
* Proficient understanding of invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
* Proficient in leading OAC meetings, coordination meetings, and facilitating stakeholder meetings.
* Coordinate VDC led meetings, manage meeting minutes and drive actions to closure.
* Oversee OFCI equipment release, delivery, deficiencies, startup and commissioning.
* Ensure project compliance, track construction progress via daily logs, site inspections and QA/QC.
* Manage project close\-out and documentation.
 **Duties:**

* Manage small to medium sized projects with Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager oversight.
* Occasionally, based on Assistant Project Manager’s experience, readiness and learning development; individual may be included in larger more technical projects to assist Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager.
* Assist and or manage multiple projects concurrently and projects in various locations.
* Coordinate internal alignment on project document reviews, budgeting and financial exercises and purchase order management.
* Enforce project quality controls and safety programs through an in\-depth understanding of the partner contracts and design docs.
* Manage and provide weekly HRA inspections to adhere to VDC safety metrics.
* Perform tasks accurately and execute with minimal supervision.
* Assist Vantage PM(s) in preparing monthly financial updates and forecasts.
* Manage contractor billing to ensure accuracy of scope included in each billing and timely review of all pay applications.
* Manage change orders and review process independently. Provide timely review of change orders with accuracy of scope and costs.
* Input PO requests in the financial system, track and manage distribution process to all Vantage vendors.
* Facilitate design page\-turns, document reviews, meeting minutes, capture deliverables and action items for internal stakeholders and direct contractor design partners.
* Manage Vantage vendor partners to ensure completion of their scope and overall project completion (i.e., Signage, furniture, AV, etc.)
* As required, manage design team/contractors throughout each project.
* Work closely with VDC Ops to coordinate ongoing site activities, develop and track MOPs and provide customer support as necessary.
* Manage, organize and maintain internal file storage.
* Own internal and external project closeout requirements.
* Assist and track as\-builds, permits, and coordinate with local authorities to ensure permits and documents are current.
* Time to time, additional duties may be assigned by management.
 **Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience as a Project Engineer in Construction Project Management assisting or supervising construction projects of increasing complexity is required.
* Data Center, Owner’s Representative and/or General Contractor experience is highly preferred.
* Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project, P6, Procore and Bluebeam.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.

**Physical Demands and Special Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Additional Details**

* Salary Range: $105,000 \- 115,000 Base \+ Bonus (this range is based on California market data and may vary

jobs.title: Affordable Housing Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**


Asset Living is a third\-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single\-family home rentals, affordable housing, build\-to\-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  



  

Asset Living is a fast\-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.  



  

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

 **ASSISTANT COMMUNITY MANAGER**


The Assistant Community Manager is responsible for overseeing, under the supervision of the Community Manager, the everyday operations and financial functions of the housing community. As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration \& risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an on\-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.


As a leading affordable housing management company, we prefer the following experience in addition to the Essential Duties and Responsibilities outlined below for our affordable assets :

* *Minimum of 1 year experience with affordable housing programs, including but not limited to : LIHTC, HUD (Project Based Section 8, Section 236, PRAC, 811 PRA, USDA \- Rural Development (515\), HCD, HOME Funds and Bonds)*
* *Affordable Housing Accreditation (HCCP, HCP\-E, COS, BOS, TCS, CPO) or other applicable designations in affordable programs are preferred but not required.*

 **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**


Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non\-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non\-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end\-of\-the\-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move\-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

  

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques \& company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow\-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies \& systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

  

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.

* Assist with developing program activities, collecting participant feedback and program data, and supporting new initiatives and continuous improvement.

* Prepare and distribute musical materials and production information to musicians, stage managers, and production staff.
* Support the musical and production needs of Shababa rehearsals, performances, and special events.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

* Experience working in children's programming, family engagement, Jewish communal organizations, schools, camps, or arts\-based educational settings preferred.

* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with Jewish holidays, traditions, culture, and/or Hebrew language preferred.
* Strong written communication skills and experience preparing communications and promotional materials.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Zoom, Canva, Instagram, Facebook, and basic audio and video editing tools.
* Comfort supporting hands\-on creative programming, including crafts, experiential learning activities, music, and theatrical presentations.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***exalt*** is seeking a dynamic, passionate person to join our team. ***exalt*** elevates expectations of personal success for youth ages 15\-19 who’ve been involved in the criminal justice system. We inspire  

youth at a critical crossroads to believe in their worth, from the first steps in contemplation through the journey to create lasting behavioral change. Our powerful combination of **structured classes for tangible skill development**, **individualized**  

**support to navigate the education and justice systems**, **placement in paid internships**  

**and**  

**an**  

**alumni network of resources** equips youth with the tools and experience to avoid further criminal justice system involvement. At ***exalt***, we empower youth to see a future filled with hope – and we provide the road map to get there.

  



The Program Coordinator (PC) is an analyst and a strategic and critical thinker who is passionate about permanently moving young people’s trajectories away from systems of incarceration and court\-involvement. The PC manages young peoples’ entire process through their experience with ***exalt***, from initially assessing them in the interview phase, to meeting with them individually throughout all phases of the program to help them set and meet goals, monitoring and supporting them in internships, and collaborating with additional resources and institutions in their lives such as external stakeholders, schools and criminal justice constituents. This individual will build and manage, along with various assigned Lead Teachers, 5 cycles per year. They will be expected to be flexible to meet expectations to come into the office for in\-person operations to our office and classroom space in downtown Manhattan, as well as work remotely through our virtual model, as needed.

 **Responsibilities**


* Interview, assess and select youth referred to ***exalt*** through candidate assessment interviews and a range of additional base\-line assessments.
* Build (perform initial outreach, interviews, pre assessments and screens) as well as manage 5 cycles per fiscal year.
* Observe, assess and develop growth plans based on participants’ participation, development, strengths and challenges in ***exalt*** classes.
* Work with the Court Liaison team to screen participants who are eligible for ATI contract services.
* Collaborate with classroom teachers to develop strategies for participants to increase participation, maximize learning, and connect classroom learning to key outcome areas including avoidance of further criminal justice system involvement, increased persistence/investment in school, and long term employability.
* Meet individually with participants throughout the duration of the program to assess their progress and support them in meeting program goals; track goals and progress through Individualized Personal Plans (IPPs).
* Devise strategies to address the diverse needs of students at risk of program incompletion.
* Support young people with school re\-enrollment, transfer and to set and make progress on educational goals.
* Maintain timely and professional communication with a diverse range of external constituents including lawyers, probation officers, judges, other nonprofit staff, ensuring information is effectively conveyed regarding youth served.
* Conduct regular outreach to internship sites throughout duration of internships through regular site visits, phone calls to support youth and employers.
* Assist in developing internships throughout New York City in a wide range of employment sectors to meet youths’ various interests, experience and skill levels.
* Develop and connect participants to external resources beyond ***exalt’s*** scope to provide holistic support.
* Work closely with Managers, Directors, Teachers and other staff to collaboratively and continuously advance young people so they can attain and exceed their goals and to meet youth and employer needs and interests.

  

  

**Competencies**


* ***Demonstrated ability to work one\-on\-one and in a classroom setting with high school age youth typically resistant to educational settings.*** Must balance clear structure, accountability and discipline with engaging discussion and facilitation style to motivate participants towards high participation and commitment to program goals.
* ***Adaptability:*** Able to adapt quickly to new information and unexpected obstacles. Approaches change positively. Is able to adapt approach to specific needs, learning styles and personalities of each student.
* ***Applied learning:*** Able to learn and apply new position\-related information quickly i.e. all ***exalt*** youth interface with the juvenile or criminal (adult) justice systems. Program Coordinator must become familiar with these systems to understand their role in students’ lives and meaning in our curriculum.
* ***Cultural competence:*** has strong familiarity with and understanding of ***exalt*** students’ histories, cultures and the socio\-economic and political factors which have shaped those, and can use culturally relevant and contextualized lessons in one\-on\-one discussions and groups. Program cohorts are typically comprised of 80% Black American and Caribbean youth and 20% Latino youth.
* ***Communication:*** Clearly and effectively conveys and receives information and ideas. Demonstrates strong written, oral and listening skills.

jobs.title: Membership & Community Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Membership \& Community Partnerships Coordinator**


NYDIS inspires, connects, and equips faith communities to serve our neighbors in times of crisis and suffering, by building pathways to recovery, resilience and social justice. Our vision is a world where all people can mitigate or recover from crisis and thrive—with justice, dignity, and the unwavering certainty that they are valued and cared for unconditionally.



We are seeking a dynamic, Membership \& Community Partnerships Coordinator at our Adult Clubhouse on Manhattan’s Lower East Side/Chinatown neighborhood – Elements House\-LES, a member of Clubhouse International. Reporting to the Clubhouse Director, the Membership \& Community Partnerships Coordinator is responsible for growing Clubhouse membership, developing community and referral partnerships, expanding Transitional Employment opportunities, and supporting member engagement and retention.


**Responsibilities**  

* Engage members through relationship\-building, social practice, and a shared Work\-Ordered Day.
* Develop and implement outreach strategies to increase Clubhouse membership and referral pipelines.
* Build and maintain partnerships with hospitals, behavioral health providers, housing providers, community and faith\-based organizations, government agencies, and other referral sources.
* Conduct community outreach, presentations, tours, and other activities to generate prospective member referrals and increase awareness of Elements House.
* Identify and cultivate businesses and employers to expand Transitional Employment (TE) opportunities.
* Work collaboratively with the Employment Unit to develop and sustain TE, Supported, and Independent Employment partnerships.
* Coordinate outreach to inactive and under\-engaged members and identify barriers to participation and strategies for reconnection.
* Support the orientation and integration of new members into the Clubhouse community.
* Collaborate with the Assistant Director and Clubhouse team on membership, engagement, retention, and ADA strategies.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation and reporting related to membership growth, referrals, partnerships, outreach, retention, and employment development.
* Participate in Clubhouse International training, staff meetings, quality improvement activities, and other professional development as required.
* Ensure compliance with Clubhouse International Standards, NYDIS policies, DOHMH requirements, and applicable confidentiality requirements.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications include**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 3\+ years of experience in behavioral health, community outreach, or related services.
* Experience working with individuals with serious mental illness strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing community, referral, employer, or institutional partnerships.
* Familiarity with the Clubhouse model and Transitional Employment preferred.
* Ability to work collaboratively with members and staff.
* Bilingual candidates strongly preferred, particularly Chinese dialects and/or Spanish.
* Strong written communication skills and comfort with digital platforms and electronic records


Salary range, $70,000\-$80,000 commensurate with experience – with excellent benefits.


**No Phone Calls: Send a Cover Letter, Resume \& 3 Professional References to** **\[email protected]****.**


*All qualified candidates should apply – candidates from ethnic and religious minorities are strongly encouraged to apply. NYDIS does not discriminate against any individual or group for reasons of age, color, creed, culture, gender, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or race.*

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Content Creation Coordinator
jobs.description:
maman \- Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator


Role based in: New York, NY


Reports to: Digital Marketing \& Content Manager

  

maman is a french bakery, café and leading lifestyle brand founded in 2014 by owners elisa marshall \& benjamin sormonte, with locations across north america and canada. inspired by family traditions, and the highest quality ingredients, maman offers a selection of delicious baked goods {including their famous nutty chocolate chip cookie}, coffee, fresh breakfast, and lunch options spanning from hearty salads \& sandwiches to savory quiches. in addition to hosting intimate events, maman has partnered with leading brands for partnerships and activations. from baby showers and birthday parties to engagements, they're able to help celebrate customers \& make new beautiful memories.


We’re looking for a creative, organized, and digitally savvy Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator to join our marketing team! Our ideal candidate is a natural storyteller and strong writer who is genuinely excited to make content, engage with our community, and help bring a distinct and engaging voice to maman’s digital channels. They are passionate about social media, hospitality, food, and digital culture, with a strong visual eye and an instinct for turning campaign priorities into social\-first content people want to watch, share, save, and talk about.


Reporting to the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager, this person will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social media channels, with a primary focus on content creation, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement. They will bring broader campaign strategy and messaging to life through Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, captions, and recurring content series, while helping shape maman’s social voice in a way that remains warm, playful, and unmistakably on\-brand. P.S. must love cookies!

  

What you'll do:


SOCIAL MEDIA \& CONTENT CREATION

* Own the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Concept, capture, edit, schedule, and publish social content across Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, and recurring series with support from the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager.
* Create short\-form video content in cafés, at events, during store openings, and on set, ensuring footage feels polished, on\-brand, and platform\-native.
* Maintain the social media calendar and ensure all content is published accurately, on time, and aligned with campaign priorities.
* Handle daily community engagement across comments, DMs, tags, mentions, and guest questions.
* Coordinate with local marketing coordinators and café teams to source stories, capture content, and support market\-specific initiatives.
* Maintain an organized library of raw footage, edited content, photography, and approved social assets.

  

COPYWRITING \& BRAND VOICE

* Assist with short\-form video text, scripts, retail product descriptions, ad copy, community responses, and other guest\-facing messaging.
* Ensure all copy reflects maman’s established brand voice and feels clear, thoughtful, and engaging.
* Proofread guest\-facing content for tone, grammar, spelling, links, dates, pricing, location details, and overall accuracy.

  

DIGITAL MARKETING SUPPORT

* Support digital campaigns across social, email, website, app, partnerships, and other digital channels.
* Assist with seasonal launches, partnerships, photoshoots, promotions, events, new\-store openings, and broader brand initiatives.
* Help with email copy, ad copy, website copy, campaign recaps, research, and special projects as needed.

  

What we’re looking for:

* 2–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, or a related field.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating polished iPhone content capture, short\-form video editing, and social\-first storytelling. Experience with Adobe Premiere preferred.
* Experience maintaining a social content calendar and publishing across multiple channels.
* A visual eye and understanding of what makes content feel engaging, polished, and on\-brand.
* Have an understanding of brand voice and the ability to apply it consistently across different platforms.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple drafts, deadlines, and priorities.
* Kind, passionate, curious, collaborative, detail\-oriented, highly accountable, and always willing to lend a hand.

  

Why work with us:

* Join a fast\-growing company committed to not just serving the best cookies and coffee, but building a national lifestyle brand.
* Comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, 401K, commuter benefits \& more.
* Support to help you settle into the role and learning opportunities to broaden your skill set.
* The opportunity to work across social media, content, hospitality, events, partnerships, and community\-building.
* Generous employee discount.
* A collaborative and creative team environment where new ideas are encouraged!
* Great opportunity to progress with maman, with internal mobility and growth encouraged when possible.


Keep in mind that maman is growing and developing every day. We all do a little bit of everything and like to roll up our sleeves to help a colleague out!


We are looking for awesome, hard\-working people that are all about creating the most memorable experience for every single maman customer.  

  

Thank you for your interest in maman and look forward to speaking with you!

jobs.description:
Manages and maintains relationships with an assigned portfolio of contracted and prospective providers, serving as a primary liaison between VNS Health Plans and provider organizations. Responsible for supporting provider engagement, operational performance, contract implementation, education, and resolution of provider\-related issues. Works collaboratively with internal departments and provider leadership to address complex operational, contractual, claims, compliance, quality, and service\-related matters. Monitors provider needs and performance, identifies trends and opportunities for improvement, and coordinates appropriate follow\-up and resolution. The role requires general direction, strong relationship management skills, knowledge of managed care operations and government\-sponsored programs, and the ability to effectively navigate and coordinate across multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  

  

  

What We Provide

  

* Referral bonus opportunities
* Generous paid time off (PTO), starting at 20 days of paid time off and 9 company holidays
* Health insurance plan for you and your loved ones, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability
* Employer\-matched 401k retirement saving program
* Personal and financial wellness programs
* Pre\-tax flexible spending accounts (FSAs) for healthcare and dependent care and commuter transit program
* Generous tuition reimbursement for qualifying degrees
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement and CEU credits
  
What You Will Do
* Manages an assigned portfolio of provider relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for provider leadership and key stakeholders and maintaining ongoing engagement to support strong provider relationships and network performance.
* Supports the implementation and ongoing administration of provider agreements, including provider education, contract requirements, operational expectations, demographic updates, renewals, and coordination with Contracting and Network teams.
* Educates providers on VNS Health Plans policies, procedures, contractual requirements, government program requirements, eligibility, operational processes, and other health plan initiatives.
* Monitors provider performance, identifies trends, gaps, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to develop and implement appropriate resolutions.
* Coordinates resolution of complex provider issues involving claims, billing, configuration, credentialing, contracting, quality, compliance, utilization, member service, and other operational matters, while maintaining ownership of the provider relationship through resolution.
* Serves as a liaison between providers and internal departments, facilitating communication and coordinating cross\-functional efforts to address provider concerns and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Leads and/or participates in provider meetings, business reviews, education sessions, site visits, and other provider engagement activities; prepares relevant materials and communicates organizational priorities and expectations.
* Coordinates provider\-related initiatives and special projects, including implementation of new programs, regulatory requirements, operational changes, and other health plan initiatives impacting the provider network.
* Reviews provider data, reports, and other available information to identify discrepancies, trends, and potential areas of risk and escalating issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Partners with Compliance and other internal departments support Department of Health, regulatory, contractual, and internal audits and assist with provider follow\-up and corrective actions as appropriate.
* Maintains accurate and timely documentation of provider interactions, activities, issues, and follow\-up within designated systems and tools.
* Provides feedback to internal stakeholders regarding provider concerns, operational barriers, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve provider processes and the overall provider experience.

Maintains current knowledge of VNS Health Plans products, provider network operations, applicable Medicare and Medicaid requirements, regulatory expectations, and organizational policies and procedures.  
* 

  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**
  

  

Drivers license required
  

  

**Education:**  

  

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent related work experience and relevant professional experience, preferably in healthcare, business, public health, health services, or a related field required
  

  

**Work Experience:**
  

  

Minimum three years of experience in provider relations, account management, managed care, healthcare operations, network management, contracting, or a related healthcare field required
  

  

Working knowledge of government\-sponsored healthcare programs, including Medicare and Medicaid, and their impact on provider operations, reimbursement, eligibility, and regulatory requirements preferred
  

  

Prior experience in Provider Relations, Provider Network Management, Account Management, Contracting, or a related healthcare function preferred  

  

  



  

  

**Pay Range**
  

  

USD $37\.32 \- USD $46\.66 /Hr.
  

  

**About Us**
  

  

VNS Health has been committed to meeting the needs of New Yorkers for over 130 years. We’re one of the largest nonprofit home\- and community\-based health care organizations in the country, and today, more than 11,500 team members work together to make a difference in the lives of more than 99,000 patients and members on any given day.

Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible.


We’re a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients.


In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals — supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide.


Backed by nearly $100 million in funding, we’re growing in the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, and Monash Health.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for an Account Manager to lead AI\-native growth across your specialty pod in the US. You'll build strategic relationships with executive\-level decision\-makers, understand complex clinical and operational needs, and drive adoption of Heidi's agentic workflows to produce measurable outcomes for the practices you own.


This is a quota\-carrying, consultative sales role: you will diagnose friction in a customer's workflow, build the business case for the agent that solves it, and own the relationship all the way through renewal.


You'll need sharp commercial instincts and the technical range to guide a customer through implementations that carry clinical complexity.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build lasting strategic, consultative relationships with executives in your specialty pod, working to deeply understand their business
* Own seat expansion and multi\-product agentic upsell across your book \- Use your knowledge of the customer and the healthcare industry to spot where an agent can change their outcomes, and build the case for it
* Become fluent in Heidi's full product suite, its technical nuances, upcoming roadmap, and best practices, so you can point each customer to the right solution
* Pair with Clinical Engineers to turn a customer's business requirements into a working technical implementation
* Own renewals above your pod's contract\-value threshold, driving retention, and multi\-year contracts.
* Monitor usage and credit consumption patterns, proactively addressing underutilization to protect and grow the account
* Forecast expansion pipeline accurately, backed by frequent customer touchpoints and clean data

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* A track record of hitting or exceeding quota in a commercial or account management role, ideally across both seat\-based and usage\-based (credit\-consuming) models
* Deep clinical understanding, or the ability to earn it fast. You need to be credible in the room with clinicians, not just executives. Healthcare or health tech experience, a plus
* Exceptional product intuition and a track record of rapidly adopting, championing, and extracting value from modern SaaS and AI technologies. Excels at mastering new tools quickly
* Experience delivering a business case that lands with a C\-suite buyer
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Great at making complicated things easy to understand
* You’re a natural relationship builder with a hunter mentality
* You’re a cross\-functional collaborator \- you represent the customer internally with ease and can reign in cross functional teams to solve complex issues
* Sound judgment and the willingness to build your own solution when there isn't a playbook yet


Compensation Range: $115K \- $135K

jobs.description:
The **Account Manager \- Third\-Party Logistics (3PL)** is responsible for managing, retaining, and growing strategic customer relationships. They serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for their assigned accounts and are responsible for driving customer satisfaction, retention, operational performance, and long\-term revenue growth. They partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and ensure service excellence. The position requires a deep understanding of customer operations and supply chain strategies, and the ability to leverage data to identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, resolve complex challenges, and deliver solutions that enhance customer value and profitability.

 **Pay Range:** $72,000\-$88,000 per/year

 **Category Focus: 3PL Partnerships**  

* Support a portfolio of third\-party logistics partners and transportation intermediaries.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer transportation networks, operational requirements, and business objectives.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key decision\-makers across assigned 3PL accounts.
* Identify opportunities to increase shipment volume, expand share of wallet, and grow existing business.
**Responsibilities:**  

* Manage a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, building and maintaining strong relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, commercial, and leadership levels.
* Understand customer supply chain strategies and align solutions to support those initiatives.
* Position the Company as a preferred transportation provider within partner logistics networks.
* Monitor and analyze account performance, revenue trends, customer satisfaction, and retention risks to identify opportunities and recommend actions.
* Identify organic growth opportunities, share\-of\-wallet expansion opportunities, and additional transportation solutions within existing accounts.
* Establish and maintain customer\-specific performance metrics and fact\-based reporting to identify root causes, lead corrective action planning, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create, prepare, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive business reviews, presenting operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and developing strategic action plans.
* Act as a customer advocate within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and aligning resources to support customer commitments and business objectives.
* Drive account retention, expansion, and profitability by identifying growth opportunities, developing strategic account plans, and supporting contract renewals and commercial negotiations.
* Maintain accurate account plans, customer activity, business opportunities, and pipeline visibility within Salesforce and other business systems.
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Pricing, Commercial, and other internal teams to improve account performance, customer experience, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Sales on growth opportunities, RFP responses, customer expansions, and win\-back initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Support customer onboarding, implementation activities, and service launches.
* Manage customer escalations, service concerns, and operational challenges through effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain CRM documentation, account activity, forecasting information, and customer records.
* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.
**Qualifications**  

* Education: Undergraduate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field from an accredited college or university required.
* Experience: 3\+ years’ experience in logistics, transportation, 3PL, account management, or a related customer\-facing role preferred.
* Deep understanding of transportation, LTL, expedited, or related freight operations preferred.
* Strong relationship management, analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify revenue risks, growth opportunities, and customer retention strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective relationships across functions.
* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), CRMs (Salesforce), and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)
* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in an on\-site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

jobs.description:
We believe in the life\-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field because they encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence—important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports.


So if you love sports and their community\-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote\-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today.

**About the Role**


GameChanger is the \#1 youth sports app for live streaming, scorekeeping, and team management. We power millions of games each year, connecting athletes, families, and communities through technology. As we expand across sports—including continued growth in baseball and softball and rapid investment in basketball—we’re building a sales function to accelerate our next phase of growth.


We’re looking for our first Account Manager to join our growing sales organization. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales, you’ll own the customer journey after the initial sale—from a seamless handoff and onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal. This is a unique opportunity to help define and scale GameChanger’s account management motion. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and other teams to turn new partnerships into healthy, growing customer relationships while bringing the voice of the customer back into the business.


You’ll focus on two key growth areas:

* **Basketball (B2B2C):** Guiding clubs and organizations from onboarding through sustained adoption across teams, athletes, and families
* **Diamond Sports (B2B):** Retaining and expanding relationships with leagues, tournaments, and organizations in baseball and softball


If you’re energized by building trusted partnerships, thrive in a high\-ownership environment, and enjoy turning customer outcomes into durable business growth, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the customer relationship from the moment a new agreement is signed, partnering with the Account Executive on a clear handoff.

* Equip Club Directors and coaches with the guidance, resources, and communication plans they need to introduce GameChanger to teams and families.

**Drive Adoption \& Account Growth**

* Build trusted, ongoing relationships with Club Directors, league administrators, coaches, and other key stakeholders through regular, proactive check\-ins.
* Monitor customer health and adoption signals—including team setup, coach activation, parent participation, athlete claims, and fan engagement—to identify progress, gaps, and opportunities.
* Develop and execute account plans that increase product adoption, deepen engagement, and expand GameChanger across additional teams, programs, or sports.
* Coordinate targeted education, enablement, and lifecycle communications with Customer Experience and Marketing to help customers achieve their goals.

* Consistently achieve retention, renewal, adoption, and expansion goals.

**Build \& Improve the Account Management Motion**

* Help establish repeatable onboarding, account planning, adoption, expansion, referral and renewal playbooks as the function grows.

* Partner with Sales leadership to define success metrics, operating rhythms, and scalable processes for account management.

* Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding retention, renewal, adoption, or growth goals.
* Experience onboarding and managing multi\-stakeholder accounts, from senior decision\-makers to day\-to\-day users.
* Strong consultative, relationship\-building, and executive communication skills, with the ability to connect customer goals to measurable outcomes.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location,

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (U.S.)

Reports to: VP of Revenue
**About** **BrightBee**
**About the Role**

We’re looking for an SDR who has lived the reality of working in schools. This role is the front door of our sales motion: you’ll open conversations with district HR leaders and their teams, build genuine relationships across district offices, and book qualified meetings for our sales team. Your credibility as someone who has been in the building and understands what it means when a classroom or cafeteria is short\-staffed is what will set you apart.

This is a phone\-first role. You’ll spend most of your day in live conversations, working to generate interest in BrightBee solutions
**What You’ll Do**
* Conduct high\-volume, high\-quality outbound calling to K\-12 district HR contacts within assigned territories, supplemented by short, purposeful follow\-up emails
* Partner with Sales to develop a strategic, regional approach.
* Develop targeted prospect lists, researching districts, identifying the right contacts, and prioritizing outreach within strategic focus areas.
* Develop authentic relationships with everyone you reach, including front\-office staff and administrative gatekeepers, treating every conversation as an opportunity to learn about the district’s staffing needs
* Translate what you hear into concise, personalized follow\-up that reflects each district’s specific needs
* Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and own the handoff, including confirmation and reminder touchpoints that drive meeting attendance, not just meeting acceptance
* Track activity, conversations, and pipeline contributions accurately in our CRM
* Share what you’re learning from the field to help refine messaging, targeting, and outreach strategy

**What You’ll Bring**

Required
* Direct K\-12 experience as an educator, paraprofessional, substitute, or school/district staff member. You understand district operations and the daily impact of support staff shortages firsthand
* Genuine comfort and energy on the phone; you’d rather have ten real conversations than send a hundred emails
* Persistence and consistency. You’re energized by daily outreach and building familiarity with contacts over time.
* Strong self\-direction: you can take a territory or target list and independently figure out who to call and why
* Clear, simple, communication style, with the discipline to keep messages short and relevant
* Curiosity and respect in every interaction, regardless of the person’s title

**Preferred**
* Experience selling to or working with school districts
* Prior SDR, BDR, or other outbound experience
* Familiarity with CRM tools and basic prospecting research

**What Success Looks Like**
* Qualified meetings booked, and a strong show rate on those meetings
* Consistent daily call activity that builds name recognition with districts
* A growing network of district contacts who know you and take your calls
* Follow\-up that’s personalized, timely, and reflects real listening

**Location**

Remote: Able to work remotely in the following states: CA, TX, IL, IN, LA, MA, MI, NC, NJ, NV, GA, or WY
**Compensation**
OTE of $70,000\-90,000 depending on experience and location, plus full benefits, unlimited PTO, and stock options.

Base salary: 50\-60k

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Clinical Research Coordinator handles or assists with the administrative activities generally associated with the conduct of clinical trials.

* Assists with patient recruitment.
* Attends study meetings.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join Our Team**
-----------------


SFA Partners is a financial services organization that goes beyond traditional broker\-dealer, Registered Investment Advisor, and insurance agency to provide a strategic, open, and professional, business development platform for independent advisors and their clients. Our platform enables our advisors to offer clients a comprehensive planning approach to their entire financial lives – helping clients protect, preserve, accumulate, and transfer wealth.


  
**Position Summary**



The Marketing Coordinator for SFA Partners (The Strategic Financial Alliance and Strategic Blueprint) is responsible for assisting the Director of Marketing with the day\-to\-day tactical implementation of all marketing efforts that affect and support SFA Partners internal departments as well as SFA Partners financial advisors.


**Essential Functions**



Social media and Digital media:


* Assist with sourcing and/or developing content for LinkedIn assets.
* Schedule and post content to LinkedIn.
* Monitor LinkedIn analytics continually and adjust content and frequency of posts
* Manage video library and coordinate production of additional videos as needed


Email:


* Assist with formatting bi\-weekly e\-newsletters and other ad hoc email communications to the SFA Partners Community using HubSpot.
* Collaborate with Director of Marketing and internal departments to collect information for and format department email communications to advisors.


Collateral


* Edit existing brochures and other marketing materials.
* Work with outside designers.


Websites:


* Edit websites (SFA Partners, Strategic Blueprint, and The Strategic Financial Alliance) coordinating with internal departments on changes
* Edit event calendars.
* Edit contact database.


Conferences and other events:


* Assist Conference team with marketing logistics and onsite coordination when needed.
* Assist with post\-event surveys / data collection and analysis.
* Assist with podcast recordings, posting and promoting.


Vendor management: Assist Director of Marketing with outside vendor partners (public relations firm, printers, designers, production companies, promotional products vendors)


**Additional responsibilities based on candidate’s skills:**



* Make basic design edits to digital and print assets


* Coordinate with Human Resources to handle marketing\-related employee onboarding tasks


* Write original blog posts



**Qualifications**



Required:



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related field of study.


* Experience with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Pilot)


* Experience with online AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude), Adobe Acrobat, Canva


* Experience in WordPress


* Experience with HubSpot or other email marketing, social media, or website platforms.


* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.



Preferred:



* Knowledge of the financial services industry (especially broker dealers and RIA, similar to Charles Schwab, Raymond James, Edward Jones, etc).


* Experience in basic graphic design.

  
**Position Summary**



The Operations Specialist is a primary contact of our operations team, serving as the primary contact for client support inquiries. This role involves managing a wide range of client requests—both written and verbal—and is responsible for problem resolution and service support for advisors and administrative staff processing client transactions through SFA Partners. The specialist will exercise decision\-making authority as delegated by the Operations Manager and Director of Operations.


**Essential Functions**


* Review and process client account information, including account openings.
* Provide general account maintenance and support.
* Review, approve, process, and follow up on incoming funds, disbursement, and asset movement requests.
* Review and process private purchase transactions within brokerage accounts.
* Manage account processing and associated fee billing on the managed account platform.
* Utilize imaging systems and workflows to maintain accurate records.
* Ensure timely completion of tasks and adherence to high service level standards.
* Generate reports to track outstanding and recurring issues, facilitating resolution and prevention.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for all operational processes and procedures, providing support to the team.
* Cross\-train with team members and mentor new employees to enhance team skills and knowledge.
* Carry out additional duties and projects as assigned by management and leadership.
* Collaborate with other departments and external vendors to cultivate strong working relationships.


**Qualifications**


* Minimum of three years of experience in the banking or financial services industry.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and broker\-dealer operations software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in customer service.
* Demonstrated sound judgment and discretion, skilled in conflict resolution.
* Exceptional organizational abilities, time management, multitasking, and priority adjustment skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills, thriving in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Team player with a collaborative mindset and positive attitude.


**Preferred:**


* Experience in securities and/or broker\-dealer environments.
* Experience with Pershing Netx360\.
* Series 7 license.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.


We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.


We're looking for a **Recruiting Coordinator** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.


Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------


As a **Recruiting Coordinator**, you'll support the candidate and new\-hire experience from the moment a requisition opens to an employee's first day on the job. This is a remote role at the heart of how we bring new people into Scan.com. You'll be the connective tissue between hiring managers, candidates, and new starters, making sure nothing falls through the cracks as we keep growing fast.


As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Support the end\-to\-end talent coordination process, from requisition opening through to an employee's Day One
* Maintain and optimize Ashby, our applicant tracking system, so it works smoothly for hiring managers and candidates alike
* Schedule interviews across time zones, keeping the experience seamless for candidates and interviewers
* Coordinate internal interview loops and debriefs, keeping panels aligned and on schedule
* Generate offer documentation and start details for incoming employees
* Coordinate IT setup for new hires, making sure equipment and access are ready before Day One
* Manage pre\-onboarding communications so new hires feel informed and welcomed before they arrive
* Support onboarding operations through an employee's first day
* Help manage occasional requisitions, with the opportunity to build broader talent/recruitment experience over time

**THE TOP 5 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Every candidate who moves through our process has a smooth, well\-organized, and professional experience, from first interview to offer
* Ashby is running as a clean, reliable system of record, giving hiring managers and the Talent team accurate visibility into every open requisition
* New hires consistently arrive on Day One with their equipment, access, and onboarding plan fully in place, with zero last\-minute scrambles
* You've built trusted working relationships with hiring managers across the business, becoming the go\-to person for a smooth hiring process
* You've made our hiring experience more efficient by building in automations throughout the process without sacrificing quality or introducing bias

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------


You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple moving parts (interviews, offers, onboarding tasks) at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates, hiring managers, and new hires
* Experience with an ATS (we use Ashby), calendar scheduling tools, and HR systems
* A drive to collaborate with your team on building a fair, consistent, and welcoming experience for every candidate who comes through our process
* A genuine interest in growing a career in talent/recruitment, with an eagerness to take on more responsibility over time
* Comfort working independently in a remote environment while staying closely coordinated with your team
* Experience using AI and/or automation tools to improve processes, distinguishing between the activities that need to have a human in the loop and the processes where technology can save time
* Experience integrating with ChartHop is a plus

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------


At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done because of it.

* Tier 2 — For this role, the expectation is that you are AI\-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G\&A roles)


	+ AI is part of your daily default. You use it to draft, analyze, research, and pressure\-test your own thinking.
	+ You can show concrete examples where AI made your work meaningfully faster or better.
	+ You know its failure modes: you check its work, and you don't paste sensitive data into public tools.
	+ **Assessment:** We'll ask you to walk through how you'd use AI to tackle a real task from the role.

*One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.*

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS

* Paid vacation and holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage

**Assistant Community Manager****East Point, GA \| Full\-Time**  

**Pay: $22\.00–$25\.00 per hour \+ Quarterly Bonus Opportunity** **About the Role**
Axia Residential is seeking an experienced, energetic, and hands\-on Assistant Community Manager for an affordable/workforce housing community in East Point, Georgia.
This is not an entry\-level Assistant Community Manager position. We are looking for someone who has worked in a Class C, affordable, workforce, or similarly complex multifamily community with 250 or more units, and understands the realities of managing significant resident delinquency, collections, evictions, housing\-assistance programs, and challenging resident accounts.
The right person knows how to be firm but fair. You should be comfortable having difficult conversations, in person resident follow\-up, pursuing collections consistently, and holding residents accountable—while still building genuine relationships with the community.
We want someone who brings energy to the property, builds rapport with residents, and team members, and has a true passion for people and property operations. **What You'll Own:** **Collections \& Delinquency**
Collections will be a major part of this position. You will:* Begin collection efforts immediately on the 5th of each month.

* Maintain detailed delinquency tracking and follow up consistently until accounts are resolved.
* Prepare, document, and actively and consistently track Promises to Pay (PTPs) and immediately follow up on missed commitments.
* Work with residents to identify legitimate payment solutions while maintaining consistent collection standards.
* Coordinate notices, dispossessory filings, eviction documentation, court requirements, and related collection activity.

* Maintain accurate resident ledgers, notes, documentation, and collection records.

* Communicating with housing agencies and maintaining required resident documentation.
* Working with nonprofit, charitable, government, and community organizations that provide rental or housing assistance.
* Helping residents navigate available assistance while continuing to actively manage their outstanding balances.
* Tracking applications, pledges, assistance payments, documentation, and outstanding balances through completion.
* Building productive relationships with organizations that can help stabilize qualified residents.

Strong collections require strong relationships. We are looking for someone who can build trust with residents without losing accountability. It's important to:* Know the residents and understand what is happening throughout the community.
* Build rapport through consistent, respectful communication and visibility onsite.
* Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally.
* Resolve resident concerns while enforcing lease requirements and community policies consistently.

* Processing applications, renewals, notices, and lease documentation.
* Monitoring occupancy, renewals, leasing activity, and resident retention.
* Coordinating with maintenance on resident issues, inspections, work orders, and apartment turns.
* Assisting with monthly reporting, audits, resident files, and operational deadlines.
* Maintaining compliance with Fair Housing requirements, company policies, and applicable housing regulations.
* Stepping in wherever needed to help the property and team succeed.

 **Required Experience*** 4\+ years of multifamily property management experience.
* Previous Assistant Community Manager experience or substantial experience handling Assistant Manager\-level responsibilities.
* Experience working at a Class C, affordable, workforce, or operationally challenging multifamily community.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant delinquency and resident collections.
* Experience with eviction/dispossessory processes and collection documentation.
* Experience preparing and tracking Promises to Pay.
* Experience working with HUD, housing assistance, rental\-assistance programs, or similar resident programs.
* Comfortable conducting direct resident outreach, including door knocking when appropriate.
* Strong understanding of Fair Housing requirements.
* Experience with property management software such as Entrata, RealPage, Yardi, or similar.
