jobs.title: Civic Engagement Campaign Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Description: **Who We Are**
Hispanic Federation (HF) is the nation's premier Latino nonprofit membership organization. Founded in 1990, HF supports Hispanic families and strengthens Latino institutions through grantmaking and direct services in the areas of education, health, immigration, civic engagement, economic empowerment and the environment. Values that drive our work include equality, fairness, diversity and empathy. **Who We Seek**Hispanic Federation seeks a Civic Engagement (CE) Coordinator to support civic engagement efforts across three states (IL, WI, MI) under the direction of the Midwest Regional Director. The CE Coordinator will be the first point of contact with partner organizations when requesting support from HF, and they will track the partner organizations’ engagement as they complete deliverables. The CE Coordinator will also be responsible for ensuring partner organizations have needed supplies and materials to execute their outreach and engagement.
A successful candidate will be a dynamic individual possessing a breadth of campaign coordination experience and demonstrating a range of professional skills. The CE Coordinator will be onboarded to the Midwest Engagement Strategy and will be tasked with managing and implementing parts of the stated plan. This will include managing part of the initiative across multiple states with varying sizes and scopes. This ideal candidate will be passionate about building and running people\-powered campaigns. The Campaign Coordinator must be effective at time\-management, multi\-tasking, and prioritization.
This position will report to the Midwest Office in Chicago, IL. The position is hybrid and will require a minimum of 10 days onsite or in the field over the course of the month.  

  

**Position Location:** Chicago, IL
**Reports to:** Midwest Regional Director
**Status:** Position is full\-time temporary with funding ending on December 31, 2026 at the latest.  

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities*** Coordinate the Midwest office’s civic engagement efforts, working directly with our partners in Illinois, Michigan, and Wisconsin and managing tasks as part of the campaign plan.
* Liaise with campaign members to ensure their needs are met, collect, and manage data based on their outreach to ensure they are meeting their contracted deliverables.
* Work closely with Midwest Regional Director and Programs Manager to ensure ongoing awareness and quick response to emerging external and internal responsibilities and events.
* Support the development of a communications plans for specific events in partnership with HF’s Communication’s Team.
* Develop and manage a campaign calendar with deadlines and pertinent information that will serve as a guide.

Track and manage list of supplies and collateral as it relates to the Community Engagement campaign, ensure partners have everything needed to execute their plans.  
* 

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree required, at least one (1\) year of experience in civic engagement/candidate or issue campaigns is a plus
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; demonstrated ability to prepare very effective written materials in English
* Excellent interpersonal skills, with a flexible and collaborative spirit
* Ability to function well in a fast\-paced work environment and manage multiple requests and projects simultaneously, and adjust strategy to changing demands
* Computer skills including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Ability to prioritize and work under deadlines
* Enthusiasm, professionalism and a passion for serving the Latino community
* Strong commitment to Hispanic Federation's mission and core values

* Ability to implement vision, think strategically, creatively problem solve, and exercise good judgment.

jobs.description:
Office Administrator \& Marketing Coordinator

**Pet Care Plus – Chicago, IL**  
**Full\-Time or Part\-Time**

Pet Care Plus is looking for a highly organized, creative, and tech\-savvy **Office Administrator \& Marketing Coordinator** to join our team.

This is a unique hybrid position for someone who enjoys both **creating engaging social media and marketing content** and keeping the administrative side of a busy business organized.

Approximately **50% of this position will focus on social media and marketing**, with the remaining 50% supporting office administration, organization, communication, and special projects.

We are open to considering **full\-time or a part\-time candidate** depending on experience \& skillset, availability, and overall fit.

Social Media \& Marketing – Approximately 50%

A major part of this position will be helping Pet Care Plus consistently capture and share what happens inside our business every day.

Responsibilities may include:

* Create and publish content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Linked In and other relevant platforms
* Take daily photos and short\-form videos of our facility, team, services, events, and pets
* Create Reels, Stories, posts, graphics, and other engaging content
* Use **Canva** to create social media graphics, flyers, announcements, signage, promotions, and other marketing materials
* Write and edit captions and marketing copy that match the Pet Care Plus brand and voice
* Assist with maintaining a social media and marketing content calendar
* Schedule and publish social media content
* Help monitor comments, messages, engagement, and customer interactions on social platforms
* Assist with email marketing, promotions, customer announcements \& newsletters, and special campaigns
* Support marketing for daycare, boarding, grooming, events, seasonal promotions, and new services
* Help capture content during company and customer events
* Organize photo, video, and marketing assets so they can easily be reused
* Track basic social media performance and identify which types of content generate the most engagement
* Bring new ideas for content, promotions, community engagement, and ways to grow Pet Care Plus's online presence

Experience with **Canva is strongly preferred**. Experience with tools such as Meta Business Suite, CapCut, Adobe, Later, Hootsuite, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or similar marketing/content platforms is a plus.

Office \& Administrative Support – Approximately 50%

The other half of this position will provide administrative support to ownership and the management team.

Responsibilities may include:

* Monitor and organize administrative email and calendars
* Draft, edit, format, and maintain company documents
* Help organize and maintain Google Drive files and folders
* Create and publish internal announcements and communications
* Assist with scheduling, follow\-up, and general correspondence
* Open, scan, organize, and route company mail and documents
* Order office and facility supplies
* Assist with inventory tracking and organization
* Provide phone and voicemail support as needed
* Coordinate paperwork and documentation with vendors, contractors, and other outside partners
* Assist with collecting documents and maintaining project files
* Help ownership and management with administrative projects and follow\-up
* Maintain organized electronic records
* Assist with miscellaneous projects as business needs arise

Who We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who can move comfortably between **creative work and detailed administrative work**.

You should be:

* Highly organized and dependable
* Comfortable working independently and managing your own priorities
* Creative and genuinely interested in social media and marketing
* Comfortable taking photos and videos and turning them into polished content
* Experienced with or eager to become highly proficient in Canva
* A strong written communicator
* Detail\-oriented and able to proofread your own work
* Comfortable learning new technology and software
* Able to manage multiple projects without losing track of deadlines
* Professional when communicating with employees, customers, vendors, and management
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving small\-business environment where priorities sometimes change
* Comfortable working with dogs

Technology \& Skills

Experience with some combination of the following is preferred:

* Canva
* Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
* Meta Business Suite
* CapCut or similar video\-editing software
* Google Workspace, including Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Calendar
* Microsoft Office
* Email marketing platforms
* Social media scheduling tools
* Project\-management or task\-management software

You do **not** need experience with every platform. We care most about finding someone who is organized, creative, technologically capable, and able to learn new tools quickly.

Schedule

This position may be structured as **full\-time or part\-time** based on the candidate.

We have flexibility with the schedule, but the position is primarily **on\-site at Pet Care Plus in Chicago** because creating authentic photo and video content from inside the business is an important part of the role.

Some flexibility may occasionally be needed for special events, promotions, or projects.

Why Pet Care Plus?

Pet Care Plus is an established Chicago pet care company providing daycare, boarding, grooming, and other services. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our administrative and marketing operations—not simply someone to complete a list of tasks.

This position offers a lot of variety and an opportunity to have a visible impact on how our company operates, communicates, and presents itself to our customers and community.

IRCA is a prominent international provider of semi\-finished ingredients for the bakery, pastry, and gelato markets. They cater to independent producers as well as large food manufacturers, including consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. The company's core product offerings consist of chocolate, chocolate decorations, creams, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and various other bakery and pastry ingredients.



Headquartered in Italy, IRCA was acquired by Advent International, a global private equity firm, in July 2022\. The company has demonstrated a strong history of growth over the past decade. As part of its growth strategy, IRCA made two bolt\-on acquisitions in 2022\. They acquired Cesarin, a provider of candied fruits, and Anastasi, a supplier of pistachio ingredients. These acquisitions expanded IRCA's product portfolio and market reach.



More recently, IRCA acquired the leading manufacturer of sweet and cereal products in Europe and the US. The target company focuses on high\-value specialty ingredients for the Food Manufacturers segment. Their product range includes sweet particulates, chocolate confections, baked inclusions, variegates, and fruit purées. This deal, successfully completed in March of 2023, is a transformative move for IRCA, establishing them as a global leader in the semi\-finished ingredients industry.

jobs.title: Account Manager - 3PL
jobs.description:
The **Account Manager \- Third\-Party Logistics (3PL)** is responsible for managing, retaining, and growing strategic customer relationships. They serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for their assigned accounts and are responsible for driving customer satisfaction, retention, operational performance, and long\-term revenue growth. They partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and ensure service excellence. The position requires a deep understanding of customer operations and supply chain strategies, and the ability to leverage data to identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, resolve complex challenges, and deliver solutions that enhance customer value and profitability.

 **Pay Range:** $72,000\-$88,000 per/year

 **Category Focus: 3PL Partnerships**  

* Support a portfolio of third\-party logistics partners and transportation intermediaries.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer transportation networks, operational requirements, and business objectives.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key decision\-makers across assigned 3PL accounts.
* Identify opportunities to increase shipment volume, expand share of wallet, and grow existing business.
**Responsibilities:**  

* Manage a portfolio of strategic customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, building and maintaining strong relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, commercial, and leadership levels.
* Understand customer supply chain strategies and align solutions to support those initiatives.
* Position the Company as a preferred transportation provider within partner logistics networks.
* Monitor and analyze account performance, revenue trends, customer satisfaction, and retention risks to identify opportunities and recommend actions.
* Identify organic growth opportunities, share\-of\-wallet expansion opportunities, and additional transportation solutions within existing accounts.
* Establish and maintain customer\-specific performance metrics and fact\-based reporting to identify root causes, lead corrective action planning, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Create, prepare, and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and executive business reviews, presenting operational and financial performance, identifying opportunities for growth, and developing strategic action plans.
* Act as a customer advocate within the organization, influencing internal stakeholders and aligning resources to support customer commitments and business objectives.
* Drive account retention, expansion, and profitability by identifying growth opportunities, developing strategic account plans, and supporting contract renewals and commercial negotiations.
* Maintain accurate account plans, customer activity, business opportunities, and pipeline visibility within Salesforce and other business systems.
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Pricing, Commercial, and other internal teams to improve account performance, customer experience, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Sales on growth opportunities, RFP responses, customer expansions, and win\-back initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Support customer onboarding, implementation activities, and service launches.
* Manage customer escalations, service concerns, and operational challenges through effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain CRM documentation, account activity, forecasting information, and customer records.
* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.
**Qualifications**  

* Education: Undergraduate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field from an accredited college or university required.
* Experience: 3\+ years’ experience in logistics, transportation, 3PL, account management, or a related customer\-facing role preferred.
* Deep understanding of transportation, LTL, expedited, or related freight operations preferred.
* Strong relationship management, analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify revenue risks, growth opportunities, and customer retention strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective relationships across functions.
* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), CRMs (Salesforce), and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)
* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in an on\-site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

* Update and maintain customer opportunity pipelines and potentials in the CRM system
* Complete sales and revenue\-related reporting.
* Drive commercial and functional excellence based on guidance/input from Commercial Excellence Function.

**About Us**
============


Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.  

For the better. Together.

  


This position has a base compensation range of USD 175,000\.00 to USD 200,000\.00\. In addition to this base compensation, you'll benefit from our competitive health and welfare programs, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, opportunities for tuition assistance, and incentive compensation for eligible positions. Salary determination considers your skills, experience, job location, internal pay equity and job architecture. Hellmann Worldwide Logistics regularly reviews our pay ranges against industry standards to ensure fairness.  

  

The National Account Management Representative, Ecommerce \- USA is focused on hunting new key Ecommerce customers – online retailers, marketplaces, D2C brands and omnichannel players – within the United States, while managing and growing strong relationships with existing key accounts. Success in this role is driven by the promotion of tailored, solution\-oriented Ecommerce logistics services (parcel, last\-mile, fulfillment, cross\-border, returns) across all Hellmann products and by confident external and internal stakeholder management. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage Ecommerce key accounts within an assigned portfolio and maintain strong customer relationships to promote retention, growth, and customer satisfaction.
* Develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities to expand services and increase revenue within existing Ecommerce accounts.
* Understand customer supply chain requirements, including peak season planning, order fulfillment, parcel logistics, last\-mile delivery, cross\-border transportation, and returns management.
* Design and present customized Ecommerce logistics solutions that address customer business objectives and operational challenges.
* Prospect, qualify, and develop new Ecommerce business opportunities through outbound sales activities, cold calling, networking, referrals, trade shows, industry events, and digital prospecting.
* Negotiate pricing, contractual agreements, and service solutions consistent with company policies and profitability goals.
* Collaborate with local and regional sales teams to identify and develop cross\-selling opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Conduct customer meetings, sales presentations, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Lead Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and Annual Business Reviews as required.
* Partner with Product Management, Operations, Customer Service, and Pricing teams to develop competitive Ecommerce logistics solutions and proposals.
* Participate in RFQs, RFPs, tenders, and customer implementation activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer, pipeline, and sales activity records within the company CRM system (HISA).
* Monitor sales performance against established targets and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Execute sales strategies, initiatives, and programs established by global, regional, and local sales leadership.
* Remain current on industry trends, Ecommerce market developments, competitive activity, and emerging logistics technologies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and applicable laws and regulations.
* Travel as required to support customer meetings, industry events, and business development activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**


This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Associate degree, vocational training, apprenticeship, or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing, or a related field required.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of four (4\) years of sales, account management, business development, or customer\-facing experience.
* Experience selling logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, parcel, fulfillment, Ecommerce, or supply chain solutions preferred.
* Demonstrated success in new business acquisition and account growth.
* Experience with CRM systems and pipeline management.
* Freight forwarding and international logistics experience preferred.
* Experience supporting Ecommerce, online retail, marketplace, direct\-to\-consumer (DTC), parcel, fulfillment, or cross\-border logistics solutions preferred.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

* Customer\-focused with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness.
* Proven hunting and farming sales mentality.

**Company Description**  

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon's Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day\-to\-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution\-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.  

  

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands\-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support
  

* Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
* Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
* Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

  

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration
  

* Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
* Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
* Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

  

Reporting and Analytics Support
  

* Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
* Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
* Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
* Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

  

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement
  

* Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
* Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how\-to materials.

* Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
* Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
* CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
* Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
* Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.

* Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced environment.
* Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go\-to\-market operations.

  

Preferred  

* Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
* Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
* Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

  

Ideal Candidate  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service\-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.  

  

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Requisition ID:** 73076

**About Whirlpool Corporation**

  

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant  

pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.\-based manufacturer of kitchen  

and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving  

needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid,  

JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported  

approximately $16 billion in annual net sales \- close to 90% of which were in the Americas \-  

41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional  

information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

**This role in summary**
------------------------

  

Whirlpool is currently seeking qualified candidates for a Social Manager, Brand Communications. This is an onsite role at our World of Whirlpool Office located in Chicago.

  

As part of the Social Media team at Whirlpool, this role is responsible for leading the strategy and execution for best in class social across our portfolio of brands. Coordinating with media, creative and brand counterparts, you will be responsible for ensuring we’re continuing to reach AND engage with our consumers across multiple social platforms.

  

The Social team is part of the Brand Organization*.* The team is comprised of social, content creation and influencer expertise to ensure we’re moving at the speed of social and bringing our brands to the forefront of culture. All members of the team provide expertise and support to both our brand leads, while also collaborating directly with our in\-house agency, WoW studios and bringing a social first approach to our campaigns. The position reports to the Senior Manager, Social and Influencer

**Your responsibilities will include**
--------------------------------------

* Leads the social strategy and execution end to end
* Owns/plans content calendars for always on \+ Influencer content
* Lead the daily community management, to maintain an active and responsive community, to drive more positive interactions \- while also infusing engagement full circle to new briefs.
* Collaborates with our influencer lead to expand reach and credibility within social communities.
* Partner with Strategy, Insights, Analytics, Comms and Media teams to ensure that all work is grounded in community understanding, data and insights
* Keeps abreast of the latest social media trends and best practices and shares out with broader organizations.
* Maintain a high level of quality assurance while holding the team accountable for delivering social first campaigns
* Be a cross\-functional teammate who engages, listens and collaborates with internal teams on Whirlpool’s overall marketing strategy.
* Be an inspiring peer and help develop out of the box and first\-to\-market experiences, activations, and content that will drive social conversations and increase brand love.
* Analyze key performance metrics regularly, making vital recommendations for improvement.
* Lead in social trafficking of assets for paid initiatives, while also having experience boosting always on content directly
**Minimum requirements**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7\+ years of experience in Social Media or Social Strategy
* 5\+ years of experience with multi\-channel communications planning, using data to identify insights and build strategies for social content
* 5\+ years of experience across all social platforms, including but not limited to: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube and LinkedIn
**Preferred skills and experiences**
------------------------------------

* A motivated social manager ready to take ownership of projects, present to teams, and eventually mentor and grow junior talent
* A passion for social, including a natural curiosity for trendspotting and identifying new channel opportunities.
* High comfort level with data and the ability to monitor, analyze, and interpret social media metrics and transform those insights into new opportunities
* Comprehensive and deep understanding of social platforms and the role they play within the broader strategy team
* Driven by a passion for evolving technologies
**What we offer**
-----------------

  

Generous benefits package, Whirlpool employee discount, fitness \& educational reimbursement programs, kitchenettes, and more! Saint Joseph/Benton Harbor locations: Beautiful, recently renovated office space, free coffee, biking/walking trails, and access to The Eddy \- Early Childhood Center (depending upon availability \- additional costs required).

**Additional information**
--------------------------

  

Whirlpool’s Ways of Working


Our goal is to provide an environment that helps you bring your best to Whirlpool every day. We offer flexibility and industry\-leading time\-off benefits that will help you balance what’s important at work and at home, including:

* **Always On Flexibility** \- You will have the autonomy to manage personal, family, and outside\-of\-work commitments as needed.
* **Two\-Week Work from Anywhere** \- Minimum of one\-week increments for a total of two weeks per year.
* **Sabbatical** \- Four weeks paid leave after every five years of service.

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool Corporation


See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. **Salary:****$26\- $30/per hour, plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Site Coordinator**

**Status:****Full\-Time; 30 hrs/week, Non\-Exempt (School year end: June 2, 2027\)**

 **Position Description:**


Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist (Academic Tutor/Behavioral Coach) is responsible for providing academic tutoring, educational support and behavioral coaching to youth during the school day and in after school programs. The position is responsible for tutoring high school students in core academic classes such as English, Math, Science, Social Studies, etc. The position will also support a variety of enrichment activities as needed.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide one\-on\-one and group academic tutoring in core subject areas and behavioral coaching to students.
* Collaborate and coordinate with school day teachers, counselors, and after school staff to identify high needs students who need educational support.
* Provide 1:1 light case management to students who need social emotional learning and behavioral health support.
* Provide training and support to high school volunteer tutors as needed.
* Create incentive plans to encourage student engagement and retention.
* Develop and support a variety of skill building and project based learning activities for youth as needed.
* Support outreach and marketing strategies to recruit and retain youth in afterschool and summer programs.
* Establish and maintain a positive and safe learning environment for program participants including assisting with classroom and behavior management, resolving and mediating conflicts using restorative practices, handling emergencies and injuries, etc.
* Work collaboratively with the school leadership team, community partners, and faculty to design and align programs to support the school’s goals for student development, academic achievement, social and emotional learning.
* Make contact with parents/caregivers in a professional and consistent manner to advise parents on youths' progress and challenges.
* Work with school faculty and parents/guardians to maintain a high level of communication and positive relationships/climate between school and families.
* Assist with data collection and produce programmatic reports as requested by funders and supervisor.
* Assist with administering and collecting evaluation data as required by funders and for continuous program improvement.
* Participate in regular staff meetings and attend on\-going training opportunities as needed.
* Maintain the cleanliness and organization of all shared program spaces.
* Complete other duties as assigned by supervisor.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields preferred plus 2 years of proven experience in youth development or experience in providing academic support.
* Knowledge of youth development practices and one or more years of experience planning and facilitating enrichment activities for youth.
* Experience in classroom management, conflict mediation, and restorative practices is a plus.
* Experience working with diverse youth and families is a plus.
* Ability to develop, implement, and organize programs and special events.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills (both oral and written).
* Possess good organizational, communication and teamwork skills.
* Capacity to multi\-task, work independently, and meet strict programmatic deadlines.
* Good technology skills (familiar with Google docs \& sheets, MS Office, etc.)
* Ability to model to staff and participants: professionalism, personal responsibility, a strong work ethic and positive character.
* Bilingual in Spanish and Cantonese/Mandarin, is highly preferred.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring a **Field Marketing Manager** to own a segment for field marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.
* Work ethic that matches our pace – sleeves rolled up, high throughput, and clear prioritization.

**Additional Information**

**Sales Development Representative (San Francisco, CA)**  

You don't pay us. We pay you.


SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full\-time job that includes free sales training, a 90\-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long\-term sales role at one of our 400\+ partner companies.


Cohorts begin every week and are limited to **25 Residents**. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Compensation**

* **Days 1–10** — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor\-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT).
* **Days 11–100** — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base \+ 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W\-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* **Day 100 onward** — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $65k \- $100k in total annual compensation (base \+ commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.


No tuition. No loans. No deferred\-income agreement.


We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor\-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (EDT or PDT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full\-time at one of our partner companies as a W\-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**


Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full\-time tech sales careers and worked with 400\+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high\-growth verticals.


Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15\+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt\-free pathways into tech careers.


Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**


No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators


If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20\-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today.** The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first\-reviewed basis.

 **Requirements**  

  

Required Qualifications:* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without need for sponsorship


Preferred Qualifications:* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer\-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal\-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2\-week bootcamp
* Strong communication skills
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high\-performance environment

  

**Benefits**  

* Comprehensive 2\-week online bootcamp training
* Paid 3\-month residency with an employer partner
* Hybrid work environment
* Exposure to leading technology companies and sales teams
* Professional development and mentorship opportunities
* Supportive community and network of peers

This role also supports holiday celebrations, ATiD – 92NY's Hebrew School, family engagement initiatives, and other children's programming that advances the Bronfman Center's mission.

Kennedy International School is seeking a positive, entrepreneurial and collaborative Communications and Social Media Content Coordinator. Reporting to the Marketing and Communications Manager, this position coordinates the school's outward\-facing editorial content, social media channels, electronic newsletters, website communications, and parent\-facing communication channels.


The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer, editor, content creator and visual communicator who is highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable balancing both strategic planning with the daily creation, publishing, and management of content.


The Coordinator serves as part of the Marketing and Communications Team, which is the primary steward of the school's outward\-facing content and editorial workflow. In this role, the Coordinator will help ensure that Kennedy’s stories, programs, people, and community are represented consistently and engagingly across digital platforms. The role crafts and supports communication initiatives that strengthen engagement with prospective families, current families, students, faculty, staff, alumni, and the broader school community while ensuring consistency of messaging across all platforms.


Working collaboratively across departments and along with the Multimedia Content Coordinator, this individual identifies and develops short\-and long\-form content for editorial, website, and social media use, creates and manages social media content; maintains publishing calendars; supports community engagement across social platforms; and helps implement school\-wide communications plans and editorial standards. new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s channel ecosystem is a core revenue engine. We are hiring a **Field Marketing Manager** to own a segment for field marketing end\-to\-end: strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution.  

You will set the vision for how we activate and nurture national and regional partners, reach their HR and finance clients and prospects, design repeatable playbooks, and personally run the programs that turn partners into advocates and advocates into revenue. You will partner closely with Sales, Revenue Ops, and Corporate Events to ensure every dollar and every activation ties to measurable outcomes.**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own segment events strategy and budget end\-to\-end**. Build the annual and monthly events plan, manage the full portfolio, and reallocate spend based on ROI signals.
* **Codify repeatable segment playbooks**. Create sales activation frameworks and plays, regional toolkits, and QA checklists so programs are easy to replicate and scale with quality.
* **Execute flagship programs**. Plan and run high\-impact events and always\-on campaigns from brief to high ROI follow\-up strategies to post\-mortem, including vendor sourcing, contract negotiation, timelines and onsite excellence.
* **Own campaign and CRM operations**. Build, launch and maintain Salesforce and Outreach campaigns that attribute every touch to pipeline and revenue, with Sendoso acceleration where applicable.
* **Measure, learn, and optimize**. Define KPIs, stand up dashboards, publish retros, and use insights to shift budget towards top\-performing formats.
* **Cross\-functional leadership without formal authority**. Align Channel AEs, sales leadership, extended field marketing, demand gen, and marketing ops on priorities, calendars, and measurement. Remove blockers and keep events on track.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 4\-6 years in field, channel, or demand gen marketing, owning strategy, budget, and hands\-on execution in high\-growth SaaS.
* Proven ability to build and scale repeatable partner playbooks that drive measurable pipeline and revenue.
* Financial and operational rigor, including vendor management and budget optimization
* Salesforce and ideally Outreach and Sendoso experience, with the ability to architect campaigns that drive revenue.
* Executive communication skills, strong stakeholder management, and comfort operating with high autonomy.
* Creative problem solver who ships quickly, learns fast, and continuously raises the bar.
* Work ethic that matches our pace – sleeves rolled up, high throughput, and clear prioritization.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

  

This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.

  

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  

114,000 \- 143,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, Hospital Relations (Health Plans)
new_jobs.description:
Manages and maintains relationships with an assigned portfolio of contracted and prospective providers, serving as a primary liaison between VNS Health Plans and provider organizations. Responsible for supporting provider engagement, operational performance, contract implementation, education, and resolution of provider\-related issues. Works collaboratively with internal departments and provider leadership to address complex operational, contractual, claims, compliance, quality, and service\-related matters. Monitors provider needs and performance, identifies trends and opportunities for improvement, and coordinates appropriate follow\-up and resolution. The role requires general direction, strong relationship management skills, knowledge of managed care operations and government\-sponsored programs, and the ability to effectively navigate and coordinate across multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  

  

  

What We Provide

  

* Referral bonus opportunities
* Generous paid time off (PTO), starting at 20 days of paid time off and 9 company holidays
* Health insurance plan for you and your loved ones, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability
* Employer\-matched 401k retirement saving program
* Personal and financial wellness programs
* Pre\-tax flexible spending accounts (FSAs) for healthcare and dependent care and commuter transit program
* Generous tuition reimbursement for qualifying degrees
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement and CEU credits
  
What You Will Do
* Manages an assigned portfolio of provider relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for provider leadership and key stakeholders and maintaining ongoing engagement to support strong provider relationships and network performance.
* Supports the implementation and ongoing administration of provider agreements, including provider education, contract requirements, operational expectations, demographic updates, renewals, and coordination with Contracting and Network teams.
* Educates providers on VNS Health Plans policies, procedures, contractual requirements, government program requirements, eligibility, operational processes, and other health plan initiatives.
* Monitors provider performance, identifies trends, gaps, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to develop and implement appropriate resolutions.
* Coordinates resolution of complex provider issues involving claims, billing, configuration, credentialing, contracting, quality, compliance, utilization, member service, and other operational matters, while maintaining ownership of the provider relationship through resolution.
* Serves as a liaison between providers and internal departments, facilitating communication and coordinating cross\-functional efforts to address provider concerns and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Leads and/or participates in provider meetings, business reviews, education sessions, site visits, and other provider engagement activities; prepares relevant materials and communicates organizational priorities and expectations.
* Coordinates provider\-related initiatives and special projects, including implementation of new programs, regulatory requirements, operational changes, and other health plan initiatives impacting the provider network.
* Reviews provider data, reports, and other available information to identify discrepancies, trends, and potential areas of risk and escalating issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders.
* Partners with Compliance and other internal departments support Department of Health, regulatory, contractual, and internal audits and assist with provider follow\-up and corrective actions as appropriate.
* Maintains accurate and timely documentation of provider interactions, activities, issues, and follow\-up within designated systems and tools.
* Provides feedback to internal stakeholders regarding provider concerns, operational barriers, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve provider processes and the overall provider experience.

Maintains current knowledge of VNS Health Plans products, provider network operations, applicable Medicare and Medicaid requirements, regulatory expectations, and organizational policies and procedures.  
* 

  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**
  

  

Drivers license required
  

  

**Education:**  

  

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent related work experience and relevant professional experience, preferably in healthcare, business, public health, health services, or a related field required
  

  

**Work Experience:**
  

  

Minimum three years of experience in provider relations, account management, managed care, healthcare operations, network management, contracting, or a related healthcare field required
  

  

Working knowledge of government\-sponsored healthcare programs, including Medicare and Medicaid, and their impact on provider operations, reimbursement, eligibility, and regulatory requirements preferred
  

  

Prior experience in Provider Relations, Provider Network Management, Account Management, Contracting, or a related healthcare function preferred  

  

  



  

  

**Pay Range**
  

  

USD $37\.32 \- USD $46\.66 /Hr.
  

  

**About Us**
  

  

VNS Health has been committed to meeting the needs of New Yorkers for over 130 years. We’re one of the largest nonprofit home\- and community\-based health care organizations in the country, and today, more than 11,500 team members work together to make a difference in the lives of more than 99,000 patients and members on any given day.

**Who We Are**
--------------


Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible.


We’re a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients.


In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals — supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide.


Backed by nearly $100 million in funding, we’re growing in the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems including the NHS, Beth Israel Lahey Health, and Monash Health.

------------------


We're looking for an Account Manager to lead AI\-native growth across your specialty pod in the US. You'll build strategic relationships with executive\-level decision\-makers, understand complex clinical and operational needs, and drive adoption of Heidi's agentic workflows to produce measurable outcomes for the practices you own.


This is a quota\-carrying, consultative sales role: you will diagnose friction in a customer's workflow, build the business case for the agent that solves it, and own the relationship all the way through renewal.


You'll need sharp commercial instincts and the technical range to guide a customer through implementations that carry clinical complexity.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build lasting strategic, consultative relationships with executives in your specialty pod, working to deeply understand their business
* Own seat expansion and multi\-product agentic upsell across your book \- Use your knowledge of the customer and the healthcare industry to spot where an agent can change their outcomes, and build the case for it
* Become fluent in Heidi's full product suite, its technical nuances, upcoming roadmap, and best practices, so you can point each customer to the right solution
* Pair with Clinical Engineers to turn a customer's business requirements into a working technical implementation
* Own renewals above your pod's contract\-value threshold, driving retention, and multi\-year contracts.
* Monitor usage and credit consumption patterns, proactively addressing underutilization to protect and grow the account
* Forecast expansion pipeline accurately, backed by frequent customer touchpoints and clean data

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* A track record of hitting or exceeding quota in a commercial or account management role, ideally across both seat\-based and usage\-based (credit\-consuming) models
* Deep clinical understanding, or the ability to earn it fast. You need to be credible in the room with clinicians, not just executives. Healthcare or health tech experience, a plus
* Exceptional product intuition and a track record of rapidly adopting, championing, and extracting value from modern SaaS and AI technologies. Excels at mastering new tools quickly
* Experience delivering a business case that lands with a C\-suite buyer
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Great at making complicated things easy to understand
* You’re a natural relationship builder with a hunter mentality

* Sound judgment and the willingness to build your own solution when there isn't a playbook yet


Compensation Range: $115K \- $135K

* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Pricing, Commercial, and other internal teams to improve account performance, customer experience, and long\-term retention.
* Partner with Sales on growth opportunities, RFP responses, customer expansions, and win\-back initiatives.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities.
* Support customer onboarding, implementation activities, and service launches.
* Manage customer escalations, service concerns, and operational challenges through effective cross\-functional collaboration.
* Maintain CRM documentation, account activity, forecasting information, and customer records.
* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.
**Qualifications**  

* Education: Undergraduate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field from an accredited college or university required.
* Experience: 3\+ years’ experience in logistics, transportation, 3PL, account management, or a related customer\-facing role preferred.
* Deep understanding of transportation, LTL, expedited, or related freight operations preferred.
* Strong relationship management, analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify revenue risks, growth opportunities, and customer retention strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and build effective relationships across functions.
* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.), CRMs (Salesforce), and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)
* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in an on\-site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

They partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and ensure service excellence. The position requires a deep understanding of customer operations and supply chain strategies, and the ability to leverage data to identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, resolve complex challenges, and deliver solutions that enhance customer value and profitability.

* Support a portfolio of third\-party logistics partners and transportation intermediaries.
* Develop a deep understanding of customer transportation networks, operational requirements, and business objectives.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key decision\-makers across assigned 3PL accounts.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, building and maintaining strong relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, commercial, and leadership levels.
